Salmorejo con guindillas fritas.elaboracion:
Wash the tomatoes, cut them into pieces, put them in a blender jug and blend well. Strain the purée and return it to the blender jug.

Add the breadcrumb (torn into pieces), the garlic clove (peeled), salt (to taste) and 100 ml of oil. Blend everything well until you have a smooth cream. Pour the salmorejo into a jug, put it in the fridge and leave it to chill thoroughly.

Heat plenty of oil in a frying pan. When it is very hot, add the chillies and fry them for 2 minutes on each side. Transfer them to a plate and season.

Serve the salmorejo in four bowls and arrange the chillies on top (to one side). Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Sopa de cocido con tapioca.elaboracion:
Soak the chickpeas the night before.

Drain the chickpeas and put them in a pulse-cooking net.

Heat 2 litres of water in a pressure cooker. Add a few sprigs of parsley, the chicken thigh, the beef shin, the bones, the leek (cleaned and chopped), the spring onion (peeled and chopped) and the garlic cloves (peeled). When the water is hot, add the chickpeas, season, close the pressure cooker and cook everything for 20-25 minutes.

Remove the vegetables, meat and bones. Strain the broth, skim off the fat and set aside.

Chop the meat and set aside. Scoop the marrow out of the bones, spread it on the slices of bread and season them.

Heat the broth. When it starts to boil, add the tapioca and cook it for the time stated on the packet. Add half the chickpeas (keep the rest for another time), the chopped meat (chicken and beef shin) and a little chopped parsley.

Divide the soup between 4 soup bowls, serve with the marrow toasts and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Sopa de udon con pollo.elaboracion:
Pound the garlic (peeled) in a mortar, add the pepper, the coriander leaves and a pinch of salt and pound everything together. Add the vinegar and soy sauce, mix and set aside.

Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil in a casserole. Dice the spring onion, add it to the casserole and fry gently over a low heat. Clean the leek, cut it into quarter moons and add it. Peel the carrot, cut it the same way and add it. Remove the stalk and seeds from the green pepper, dice it and add it. Peel the red pepper, dice it and add it. Wash the celery stick, dice it and add it. Season and cook the vegetables over a low heat for about 5 minutes. Remove the vegetables, transfer them to a dish and set aside.

Add 1 more tablespoon of oil to the casserole. Dice the chicken breast, season it, add it to the casserole and fry until golden. Add the reserved vegetables, cover with plenty of water and crumble the stock cube over the top. Add the udon and the garlic paste. Grate a little nutmeg over the top and cook everything for 7-8 minutes.

Divide the soup between soup bowls and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Gazpacho andaluz.elaboracion:
Wash the tomatoes, cucumber and pepper. Peel the cucumber and the garlic clove, deseed the pepper and chop all the vegetables.

Put them in the blender jug with the vinegar, a pinch of salt and a glass of cold water. Blend until very smooth.

With the blender running, add the oil little by little so that the gazpacho emulsifies. Taste and adjust the salt and vinegar.

Strain it if you want it smoother and keep it in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Serve well chilled with a little chopped cucumber on top.

Sopa de ajo castellana.elaboracion:
Peel and slice the garlic cloves. Cut the day-old bread into thin slices and the ham into strips.

Heat the oil in a casserole and brown the garlic over a low heat. Add the ham and the bread and fry gently for 2 minutes, stirring so that the bread soaks up the oil.

Take the casserole off the heat, add the paprika and stir quickly so that it does not burn. Pour in the hot stock, season and simmer for 15 minutes over a low heat.

Beat the eggs and pour them into the soup in a thin stream, stirring with a fork so that they set in strands. Serve straight away with chopped parsley.

Crema de calabacín.elaboracion:
Peel the onion, remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, dice them and fry them gently in a casserole with 2-3 tablespoons of oil.

Clean the courgettes well, dice ½ courgette and set aside. Cut the rest into quarter moons and add them to the casserole. Fry gently for 4-5 minutes and add the stock and the rice. Season with salt and pepper and cook everything for 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and sauté the diced courgette. Set aside.

Cut the brick pastry sheets into 4, place a small portion of roe on each piece and wrap them up to make 8 little parcels. Fry them on both sides in a frying pan with plenty of hot oil, remove them, drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper and set aside.

Take the casserole with the vegetables and rice off the heat and blend everything with a hand blender. Add the evaporated milk and mix well.

Divide the soup and the diced courgette between 4 soup bowls. Serve with the brick pastry parcels and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Sopa fría de zanahoria.elaboracion:
Heat 1,250 ml of water in a pressure cooker. Peel the carrots, put them in the cooker, season, close the cooker and cook them for 4 minutes. Remove them, drain and leave to cool. Set the cooking water aside separately.

Chop the carrots and put them in the blender jug, add the apple (peeled and chopped), the cumin, some of the cooking water (according to taste: thinner or thicker) and the vinegar. Blend everything until you have a smooth cream. Add the oil little by little and keep blending until it emulsifies. Adjust the salt, put the soup in the fridge and leave it to chill thoroughly.

To make the garnish, cut the spring onion, pepper and ham into small dice, and the tomatoes into quarters.

Divide the soup between 4 soup bowls, scatter the garnish over them and decorate with a few parsley leaves.

Crema de calabaza y zanahoria.nombre: Cream of pumpkin and carrot soup
Crema de calabaza y zanahoria.elaboracion:
Peel the pumpkin, carrots, onion and potato, and cut them into medium-sized pieces.

Soften the onion in a casserole with the oil for 5 minutes. Add the rest of the vegetables, fry gently for 2 more minutes and cover with the vegetable stock.

Season and cook over a medium heat for about 25 minutes, until everything is tender.

Blend with the cream until the soup is smooth. Serve hot with a few toasted pumpkin seeds and a drizzle of oil.

Vichyssoise.elaboracion:
Clean the leeks and keep the white part. Cut it into thin rounds. Peel the potatoes and chop them.

Melt the butter in a casserole and soften the leek over a low heat for 10 minutes, without letting it brown.

Add the potatoes, cover with the stock, season and cook for 20 minutes. Blend with the cream and pass the soup through a fine sieve.

Chill it in the fridge and serve cold with chopped chives on top. It is also good hot.

Crema de champiñones.elaboracion:
Clean the mushrooms and slice them. Set a few aside for garnish. Peel the onion, garlic and potato and chop them.

Soften the onion and garlic in a casserole with oil. Add the mushrooms and sauté over a high heat until they release their water.

Add the potato and the stock, season and cook for 20 minutes. Blend with the milk until you have a smooth soup.

Sauté the reserved mushrooms with a little oil and thyme and place them on top of each bowl.

Albóndigas de hortalizas.elaboracion:
Wash the potatoes, put them in a saucepan, cover with water and cook them for 30-35 minutes (counting from when the water comes to the boil). Remove them and leave to cool slightly.

For the sauce, heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a casserole. Peel 2 garlic cloves and the onion, dice them and add them to the casserole. Trim the bottom and top of the leek and remove 2-3 outer layers, wash it, cut it into quarter moons and add it to the casserole. Peel 2 carrots, cut them the same way and add them. Season and cook the vegetables over a low-medium heat for 15 minutes. Add the tablespoon of flour and fry it well. Pour in the wine and bring to the boil. Add 300 ml of water and cook everything for 10 minutes. Blend with a hand blender until you have a smooth sauce. Set it aside and warm it up a little just before serving.

Wash the courgette, cut it into small dice and fry it gently in a frying pan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Peel the other carrot, grate it and add it. Peel the other garlic clove, cut it into small dice and add it. Season and cook the vegetables over a low-medium heat for 10 minutes. Drain them well and set aside.

Peel the potatoes, put them in a bowl and crush them with a potato masher. Season, add the drained vegetables (courgette, carrot and garlic) and mix well. Add the breadcrumbs little by little, mixing all the time, until you have a smooth mixture.

Take small portions of the mixture and roll them into balls. Coat them in flour and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of oil. Drain them on a dish lined with kitchen paper.

Spoon the sauce onto the base of the plates and place 3-4 vegetable balls on top. Garnish with parsley powder and a few parsley leaves.

Berenjenas rellenas con bechamel de ques.nombre: Stuffed aubergines with blue cheese béchamel
Berenjenas rellenas con bechamel de ques.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan and season it. Cut the aubergines in half lengthways, add them and cook them for 15 minutes. Remove them, drain, dry them well and scoop out the flesh without breaking the skin. Cut the flesh into small dice and set aside. Keep the 4 shells as well.

Peel the garlic cloves and cut them into small dice. Peel the carrot and cut it the same way. Wash the pepper, remove the stalk and seeds and cut it into small dice as well. Fry the vegetables gently in a frying pan with 3 tablespoons of oil, season them and cook them for 6-8 minutes.

Mince the turkey meat, season with salt and pepper, add it to the frying pan and cook briefly. Add the aubergine flesh and cook together for 5 minutes. Fill the aubergine shells with the stuffing and set aside.

To make the béchamel, heat the oil, add the flour and cook it for a little while. Add the milk little by little, stirring constantly until everything is well combined. Season and cook the béchamel for 6-8 minutes, stirring constantly. When it is almost ready, add the blue cheese and cook until it has melted into the béchamel.

Coat the aubergines with the cheese béchamel, put them in the oven and grill them (3-5 minutes) until golden.

Serve half an aubergine on each plate and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Pastel de patatas, jamón cocido y pancet.nombre: Potato, cooked ham and pancetta bake
Pastel de patatas, jamón cocido y pancet.elaboracion:
Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add the milk and a little chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper. Peel the boiled potatoes, chop them and add them. Mix well and set aside.

Dice the pancetta and the ham and sauté them in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil. Remove them, drain and add them to the bowl with the eggs and potato.

Grease a mould with butter and dust it with a little flour. Pour in the mixture and bake at 180 ºC for 30 minutes. Remove the bake and leave it to cool slightly.

Turn the bake out of the mould, serve it with the tomato sauce. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Pastel de calabacín al horno.elaboracion:
Spread 1 tablespoon of oil over a rectangular ovenproof dish or mould. Lay a piece of baking paper along the dish, leaving a flap at each end. Brush it with another tablespoon of oil, dust it with the 2 tablespoons of flour and spread it out well.

Peel the onions, slice them thinly and fry them gently for 6-8 minutes in a frying pan with 4-5 tablespoons of oil.

Wash the courgettes (leave the skin on), cut them into half moons and add them to the frying pan. Season and cook everything together for about 15 minutes. Drain well and set aside.

Crack the eggs into a large bowl. Add the milk, the cream, the oregano and a pinch of salt and beat everything well. Add the onion and courgette mixture to the bowl and mix gently.

Pour the mixture into the ovenproof dish, sprinkle it with the cheese and bake at 180 ºC for 30 minutes. Take the bake out of the oven and leave it to cool slightly.

Turn the bake out, cut it into portions and serve. Accompany each portion with a little hot tomato sauce. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Pisto con huevo frito.elaboracion:
Dice the onion and the peppers. Cut the courgette and aubergine into slightly larger dice.

Soften the onion and peppers in a large frying pan with oil over a low heat for 15 minutes.

Add the aubergine and courgette, season and cook for 10 more minutes. Add the crushed tomatoes and a pinch of sugar and leave to cook over a low heat for another 20 minutes.

Fry the eggs in very hot oil and serve each one on a portion of pisto.

Escalivada.elaboracion:
Preheat the oven to 200 ºC. Wash the aubergines, peppers and onions and place them whole on a baking tray with a splash of oil.

Roast them for 50-60 minutes, turning them halfway through, until they are tender and the skin is charred.

Cover them with a tea towel for 10 minutes so that they sweat and peel easily. Peel them and cut them into strips.

Arrange them on a serving dish, dress with oil, salt and the finely chopped garlic, and leave to rest for a while before serving.

Judías verdes rehogadas con jamón.elaboracion:
Top and tail the beans, remove the strings and cut them into pieces. Cook them in salted water for 10-12 minutes and drain.

Peel the potatoes, dice them and cook them with the beans for the last 8 minutes, or separately if they are large.

In a frying pan with oil, brown the sliced garlic and the diced ham. Add the paprika and take off the heat.

Add the beans and potatoes to the frying pan, sauté for 2 minutes so that the flavours blend and serve.

Alubias blancas con butifarra.elaboracion:
The night before, put the white beans in a large bowl, cover them with water, put them in the fridge and leave them to soak. Drain them, put them in a pressure cooker and cover them with water.

Clean the leek (trim the bottom and top, remove the first layer and rinse it), cut it into 3-4 pieces and put it in a pulse-cooking net. Peel the onion and add it to the net. Close the net and put it in the cooker with the bay leaf. Season, close the cooker and cook the beans for 3 minutes. Drain the beans and set aside. When ready to serve, take the vegetables out of the net, chop them a little and put them on a serving dish. Season them and drizzle with a splash of oil.

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan. Prick the butifarra sausages with a paring knife, put them in the frying pan and cook them over a medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side. Remove them and set aside on a plate. When ready to serve, cut them into thick slices.

Add the drained beans to the frying pan in which you cooked the sausages and sauté them for 2 minutes.

Serve a good portion of beans and a few slices of butifarra on each plate. Accompany with the leek and onion and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Chícaros con codillo.elaboracion:
Heat 3-4 tablespoons of oil in a pressure cooker. Peel the garlic cloves, dice them and add them to the cooker. Peel the onion, cut it into small dice and add it. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it the same way and add it. Season and cook the vegetables over a low heat for 10 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and cook for 4-5 more minutes.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a frying pan. Slice the chorizos and cut the pancetta into 1 cm pieces, add them to the frying pan and brown them well. Add them (without the fat) to the cooker.

Peel the pumpkin and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Peel the potatoes and break them into chunks (snapping them rather than cutting cleanly). Add them (pumpkin and potatoes) to the cooker. Also add the chícharos, the ham hock, the bay leaf, the paprika and the cumin. Cover everything with water, close the cooker and cook over a low-medium heat for 15 minutes.

Open the cooker, remove the ham hock and cut it into 6 pieces.

Divide the stew between 6 plates and put a piece of ham hock on each. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Lentejas con chorizo y panceta.elaboracion:
Put the pancetta in a pressure cooker, cover it with water, season, close the cooker and cook it for 30 minutes. Remove it and leave it to cool.

Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil in a casserole. Peel the spring onion and the carrot and clean the leek well (trim the bottom and top, remove 1-2 outer layers and rinse it). Dice the spring onion, and cut the carrot and leek into thin quarter moons. Add the vegetables to the casserole, season and cook them over a low-medium heat for 8-10 minutes.

Cut the chorizo into 4 pieces and add it to the casserole. Add the lentils, cover them with plenty of water (3-4 times the volume of lentils), season and simmer over a low heat for 40-45 minutes. Add the paprika and mix well.

Heat a frying pan without oil. Cut the pancetta into 4 pieces, put them in the pan and brown them on both sides.

Serve the lentils with chorizo on 4 plates and place a piece of pancetta on each. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Alubias con panceta asada.elaboracion:
Season the pork belly, place it in an ovenproof dish, drizzle with a splash of oil and roast it in the oven at 170 ºC for 30 minutes. Raise the temperature to 190 ºC and roast for another 10 minutes. Remove it and cut it into 4 pieces.

Peel the spring onion and cut it into small dice. Clean the leeks (trimming the bottom and top and removing 1-2 outer layers), rinse them well and cut them into small dice. Peel the carrot and cut it the same way. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pressure cooker, add the vegetables, season and fry gently for 10 minutes. Peel the tomato, chop it finely and add it. Cook everything together for 6-8 minutes.

Add the beans, cover them with water and season. Put the lid on, close the cooker and cook them for about 15 minutes.

Heat water in a saucepan, add the morcilla and simmer it over a low heat for 30 minutes (15 on each side). Remove it and cut it into 4 pieces.

Divide the beans between 4 plates and top each one with 1 piece of morcilla and 1 piece of pork belly. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Alubias con chorizo y arroz integral.nombre: Beans with chorizo and brown rice
Alubias con chorizo y arroz integral.elaboracion:
Soak the beans the night before.

Drain the beans and put them in a pressure cooker, cut the chorizo into 8 pieces and add them. Peel the spring onion and 2 garlic cloves, cut them into small dice and add them. Season, add 1 tablespoon of oil and the paprika and add water to cover. Close the cooker and cook the beans for 15 minutes.

Peel the other 2 garlic cloves and brown them in a casserole with 2 tablespoons of oil. Add the rice, season, cover with water (three times the volume of rice) and cook for 30 minutes.

Divide the beans with chorizo and the rice between 4 plates. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Garbanzos con panceta ibérica.elaboracion:
Soak the chickpeas the night before. Heat plenty of water in the pressure cooker. Add the chickpeas (drained), the pork belly and the black peppercorns. Season, close the cooker and cook everything for 20 minutes.

Remove the pork belly, dice it and set aside. Remove the chickpeas, drain and set aside.

Peel the garlic cloves and the spring onion, cut them into small dice and fry them gently in a large frying pan with 4 tablespoons of oil for 10 minutes. Add the chickpeas, season and sauté them.

Heat another frying pan, add 1 tablespoon of oil and the diced Iberian pork belly and cook until lightly browned.

Divide the chickpeas and the diced pork belly between 4 plates. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Lentejas con zanahorias y cúrcuma.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a pressure cooker and add the lentils.

Peel the onion, cut it into 4 and put it in a pulse-cooking net. Clean the leek (trim the bottom and top, remove 1-2 outer layers and rinse it), cut it into 4 and put it in the net. Wash the tomato, cut it into 4 and add it. Peel the garlic clove and add it. Add the bay leaf as well. Close the net and put it in the cooker.

Season, close the cooker and cook the lentils over a medium heat for 15-20 minutes.

Remove the net, open it, take out the bay leaf, transfer the vegetables to a blender beaker and blend them with a hand blender until you have a smooth purée. Add it to the cooker and stir until everything is well combined.

Peel the carrots and cut them into thin rounds. Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the carrots and sauté them for 4-5 minutes. Add the turmeric and a pinch of salt and sauté briefly (1 minute), until the turmeric coats the carrots.

Divide the lentils between 4 plates and place a portion of carrots on each. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Falafel con salsa de yogur.elaboracion:
Heat water in a pressure cooker. When it starts to boil, add the chickpeas, season, close the cooker and cook them for 15 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Peel the onion and the garlic clove, chop them finely and fry them gently for 5-6 minutes in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil.

Pass the chickpeas and the vegetables (drained) through a food mill into a large bowl. Add the chopped parsley, coriander, cumin, pepper and a pinch of salt and mix well. Add the chickpea flour and mix well until you have a smooth mixture.

Divide the mixture into small portions and roll them into balls. Fry them in a saucepan with plenty of oil until golden. Remove them and drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper.

To make the yoghurt sauce, grate the garlic (or chop it finely), put it in a bowl, add the yoghurt, lemon juice, zest, parsley, pepper and salt and mix well.

Serve the falafel with the yoghurt sauce. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Guiso del maestro.elaboracion:
The night before, soak the chickpeas.

Heat plenty of water in a pressure cooker. Add the chickpeas (drained), the ham bone, the bay leaf and 2 garlic cloves (unpeeled), lightly crushed. Peel 1 onion and add it. Close the cooker and cook the chickpeas for 20 minutes. Set aside the stock and the chickpeas.

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a shallow casserole. Peel the other 2 garlic cloves, chop them (diced or sliced) and add them to the casserole. Peel the other onion, cut it into small dice and add it. Cook the vegetables for 6-8 minutes over a low heat.

Dice the ham, add it and fry briefly (1 minute). Pour in the wine and bring quickly to the boil so that the alcohol evaporates. Add the tomato sauce and the noodles and mix well. Add 600 ml of the reserved stock and cook the noodles for about 8 minutes.

Add the chickpeas and cook everything together for 4-5 more minutes. Add a little chopped parsley and stir the casserole.

Serve and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Lentejas estofadas con verduras.elaboracion:
Chop the onion, pepper, carrot and garlic. Soften everything in a pot with oil for 10 minutes.

Add the grated tomato and the paprika, stir for a minute and add the lentils, the potato in chunks and the bay leaf.

Cover with the stock, season and simmer over a low heat for about 40 minutes, until the lentils are tender. Add more stock if needed.

Leave to rest off the heat for 5 minutes and serve.

Garbanzos con espinacas.elaboracion:
Fry the garlic cloves and the slice of bread in a frying pan with oil until golden. Transfer them to the mortar.

Add the cumin, paprika and a splash of vinegar to the mortar and pound to a paste.

In the same frying pan, sauté the spinach until it wilts. Add the cooked chickpeas, the paste from the mortar and a glass of water.

Simmer for 10 minutes over a low heat so that it thickens, adjust the salt and serve.

Fabada asturiana.elaboracion:
Soak the fabes in cold water the night before.

Drain them and put them in a pot with the chorizo, morcilla, pancetta and lacón (cured pork shoulder). Cover with cold water and bring to the boil.

Skim off the foam, turn the heat down to the minimum and add the saffron. Cook for 2 and a half hours, adding a little cold water from time to time to «shock» the fabes. Do not stir them: shake the pot instead.

Season at the end, leave to rest for 15 minutes and serve the fabes with the meats (compango) cut into pieces.

Huevos escoceses.elaboracion:
Heat water in a saucepan, add the quail eggs and cook them for 4 minutes. Remove them, cool them in cold water, peel them and set aside.

Cut the onion into small dice and put it in a bowl. Add the meat, the egg yolks and the tablespoon of breadcrumbs. Peel the apple, grate it and add it. Also add the ketchup and the grated ginger. Season with salt and pepper and mix well until everything is thoroughly combined.

Divide the mixture into 8 portions. Take a portion of meat, flatten it out a little, place a quail egg in the centre and wrap the meat around it to cover it completely and form a ball. Repeat with the rest of the meat and eggs.

Coat them in flour, egg and breadcrumbs and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of oil over a medium heat for about 5 minutes. Remove them and drain on a dish lined with kitchen paper.

Dress the escarole with oil, vinegar and salt.

Serve 2 Scotch eggs and a portion of escarole on each plate. Accompany with the mustard and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Huevos napoleón.elaboracion:
Cut the bread into cubes, put them on a baking tray and bake them at 220 ºC until golden. Remove them and set aside.

Peel the garlic cloves, chop them and brown them in a frying pan with 3-4 tablespoons of oil. Slice the spring onions thinly and add them. Remove the stalks and seeds from the peppers, cut them into large dice and add them. Season and cook the vegetables for 10-15 minutes.

Divide the vegetables between 4 ovenproof dishes and top them with the toasted bread cubes and the cheese. Crack the eggs, put 2 in each dish and season them. Put them in the oven at 180 ºC for about 8 minutes.

Serve and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Rollitos de tortilla, queso y panceta.elaboracion:
Peel the garlic clove and the onion, dice them and fry them gently in a casserole with 3-4 tablespoons of oil. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it the same way and add it. Season and cook the vegetables for 10 minutes. Add 250 ml of water and leave it to reduce for 10 minutes. Blend everything with a hand blender until you have a smooth sauce and set aside.

Crack 1 egg into a bowl, season it, add a little chopped parsley and beat it. Heat a small frying pan with a few drops of oil, pour in the egg and cook a thin omelette (like a crêpe). Repeat with the rest of the eggs.

Fry the pancetta rashers (without letting them brown) in a frying pan with a drop of oil. Transfer them to a plate and set aside.

Cut 8 sticks of cheese and grate the rest.

Lay out the omelettes, place 1 stick of cheese along one edge of each and roll them up around it. Wrap each omelette in 1 rasher of pancetta and place the rolls on an ovenproof tray or dish. Sprinkle them with the grated cheese and grill them in the oven until lightly golden.

Spoon the sauce onto the base of 4 plates and place 2 rolls on each. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Huevos teresita.nombre: Teresita eggs (stuffed eggs in ham and pea sauce)
Huevos teresita.elaboracion:
Heat water in a small pan, add the eggs and boil them for 10 minutes from the moment the water comes to the boil (to keep the yolks centred, stir them in a circular motion with a wooden spoon). Remove them, cool them in cold water, peel them and cut them in half. Separate the yolks from the whites and set them aside separately.

Heat water in a saucepan and, when it comes to the boil, add the peas. Season them and cook for 10-15 minutes (depending on size).

For the filling, peel the garlic, chop it, put it in the mortar and crush it well. Add the yolks, 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley and a pinch of salt. Crush again until you have a smooth paste (if it is too dry, you can add a little water).

Fill the egg whites with the paste and brown them (in batches) face down in a frying pan with 2-3 tablespoons of hot oil. Once sealed, remove them and set aside.

Cut the ham into small dice and brown it in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 3 tablespoons of oil. When it takes on a little colour, add the flour, cook it briefly and add the paprika. Add the stock, the peas and the eggs (face down). Cover the casserole and cook them in the sauce for 6-8 minutes.

Using a small round pastry cutter, cut 4 circles from each slice of bread. Heat plenty of oil in a frying pan and fry 1 slice of bread and 4 circles on both sides. Remove them and drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper. Repeat with the other 3 slices of bread and the 12 circles.

Place the slices of bread on 4 plates, set the stuffed egg whites in the holes and spoon over the sauce. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves and the fried bread circles.

Tortilla de patatas.elaboracion:
Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices. Peel the onion and cut it into thin strips.

Soften the potatoes and onion in plenty of oil over a medium heat for about 20 minutes, until tender but not browned. Drain them well.

Beat the eggs with salt, add the potatoes and leave the mixture to rest for 5 minutes.

Heat a frying pan with a little oil, pour in the mixture and set it over a medium heat for 3 minutes. Turn it over using a plate and cook for 2 minutes on the other side.

Huevos rotos con jamón.elaboracion:
Peel the potatoes and cut them into thick sticks. Pat them dry with kitchen paper.

Fry them in plenty of oil over a medium heat until tender, then turn up the heat at the end to brown them. Drain and salt them.

Fry the eggs in the same oil, leaving the yolks runny.

Arrange the potatoes on a serving dish, top with the eggs and the sliced ham, and break the yolks with a fork just before serving.

Huevos al plato con tomate y pimientos.nombre: Baked eggs with tomato and peppers
Huevos al plato con tomate y pimientos.elaboracion:
Chop the onion and peppers and soften them in a frying pan with oil for 15 minutes.

Add the crushed tomatoes, the cumin and the paprika, season and cook for 10 minutes until thickened.

Make four hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each one. Cover and cook over a low heat for 5-6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.

Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve in the pan.

Arroz al horno.elaboracion:
Wash the tomatoes, peel one and dice it. Cut the other 2 in half.

Heat an ovenproof tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 3 tablespoons of oil. Add the diced tomato, the whole head of garlic and the halved tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes. Peel the potatoes, cut them into 1 cm slices, add them and season.

Add the rice and stir it briefly in the oil. Add the chickpeas, the hot stock, the saffron threads and the paprika. Season and cook the rice over a high heat for 6-8 minutes. Put the casserole in the oven and bake the rice at 200 ºC for 12-14 minutes.

Take the casserole out of the oven and serve. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Arroz con costilla de cerdo.elaboracion:
Heat water in the pressure cooker and season it. Clean the leek (trim off the bottom and top, remove 1-2 outer layers and rinse it), cut it into pieces and add it to the pot. Add the ribs, close the pressure cooker and cook for 10-15 minutes. Remove the ribs, drain them and season with salt and pepper.

Heat 3-4 tablespoons of oil in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole), add the pieces of rib and fry until well browned. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Peel the spring onion, red pepper and garlic, cut them into small dice and add them to the casserole. Season and cook the vegetables over a low-medium heat for 10-15 minutes. Add the rice and stir it briefly in the oil. Add the paprika, the ribs and hot water (a little more than double the amount of rice) and cook everything for 20 minutes.

Serve the rice and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Pasteles de arroz, zanahorias y panceta.elaboracion:
Bring water to the boil in a pressure cooker, add the rice and season. Close the cooker, cook for 5 minutes, drain and set aside.

Peel the carrots and boil them for 15 minutes in a saucepan of water with a pinch of salt. Set aside.

Peel the onion and garlic cloves, dice them and fry gently for 8-10 minutes over a low heat in a frying pan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Dice the pancetta, add it and cook until browned.

Put the eggs in a bowl and beat them. Add the milk and beat again. Add the vegetables with the pancetta and the rice and mix well. Slice the carrots into rounds and add them. Mix gently, divide the mixture between 4 individual ovenproof dishes and bake at 200 ºC for 12 minutes.

Serve the bakes and garnish them with a few parsley leaves.

Croquetas de arroz con pollo y espinacas.nombre: Rice croquettes with chicken and spinach
Croquetas de arroz con pollo y espinacas.elaboracion:
Peel the garlic clove, dice it finely and brown it in a saucepan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Add the rice and the water (a little more than double the amount of rice), crumble the stock cube over the top, stir and cook the rice for 18-20 minutes. Leave it to cool.

Heat a frying pan with 1 tablespoon of oil, season the chicken breast, add it to the pan and brown it on both sides. Remove the breast, cut it into small dice and put it in a large bowl. Clean the spinach leaves, dry them, chop them finely and add them to the bowl. Add the rice and mix everything well. Crack an egg, beat it, add it to the bowl and mix again.

Take small portions of the mixture, roll them into balls, coat them in flour and beaten egg and fry them over a medium heat in a frying pan with oil. Drain them on a plate lined with kitchen paper.

Heat the tomato sauce.

Serve 5 croquettes on each plate with a little tomato sauce. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Arroz con lomo, panceta y jamón cocido.nombre: Rice with pork loin, pancetta and cooked ham
Arroz con lomo, panceta y jamón cocido.elaboracion:
Heat a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 4 tablespoons of oil. Dice the ham, pancetta and pork loin, add them and fry until browned. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Peel the onion, carrot and garlic cloves, cut them into small dice and add them to the casserole. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it the same way and add it. Season and cook the vegetables for 12-15 minutes.

Add the rice to the casserole, stir it in the oil for a moment, pour over the hot stock and cook for 12 minutes. Add the meats, stir and cook everything for 6-8 minutes more (you can finish it in the oven if you like).

Serve the rice and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Ensalada de arroz al curry.elaboracion:
Peel the garlic cloves, cut them in half and brown them in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 2-3 tablespoons of oil. Add the rice, stir it briefly, pour over water (the same amount as the rice), season and cook for the time stated on the packet. Leave it to rest for 2 more minutes. Drain it, cool it under cold water, transfer it to a large bowl and set aside.

Heat a saucepan of water. Dice the courgette and the (peeled) carrots, add them to the pan, season and cook for 5-6 minutes. Remove, drain and leave to cool.

In the same pan you cooked the vegetables in, cook the prawns for 1 minute. Remove them, leave them to cool slightly, peel them and set aside. Put the prawn heads in a mortar, crush them, add 100 ml of oil and mix well. Strain the mixture through a fine conical sieve into a bowl, add a splash of vinegar, a pinch of salt and the curry powder and mix well.

Add the courgette, carrot, half the prawns (chopped), the spring onion (finely diced), the sweetcorn and the olives (chopped) to the bowl of rice and mix everything together.

Divide the salad between 4 bowls. Garnish with the rest of the prawns and a few parsley leaves and dress with the curry vinaigrette.

Arroz cuatro delicias.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a saucepan. Add the rice, season and cook for 18-20 minutes (from the moment the water comes to the boil). Remove it, cool it under cold water, drain it and set aside.

Heat a frying pan with 1 teaspoon of oil. Beat the eggs in a bowl, season them and pour them into the pan. Cook the omelette until set, transfer it to a plate, dice it and set aside.

Dice the ham and peel the prawns.

Mix the rice, the diced omelette and ham, the prawns and the peas in a salad bowl.

Divide the rice between 4 plates, dress with the soy sauce and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Arroz con chorizo y jamón.elaboracion:
Heat water in a small pan, add the eggs and boil them for 10 minutes (from the moment the water comes to the boil). Remove them, cool them in cold water, peel them, chop them and set aside.

Heat water in a saucepan and season it. When it comes to the boil, add the rice and cook for 18 minutes. Remove, drain and set aside.

Cut the peppers into strips. Heat a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil and cook the peppers over a low heat for 10 minutes. Remove and set aside.

Cut the chorizo and ham into small dice and fry them briefly in another frying pan with 2-3 tablespoons of oil. Pour off some of the oil, add the rice, mix well and stir-fry very briefly (just to heat the rice through).

Serve the rice on 4 plates, top with the pepper strips and sprinkle with the chopped hard-boiled egg. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Arroz con tortilla y panceta.elaboracion:
Clean the lettuce, dry it, tear it into pieces and put it in a bowl. Cut the spring onion into fine strips and add it. Just before serving, dress the salad with oil, vinegar and salt.

Peel the garlic cloves, cut them in half and fry them briefly in a saucepan with 2 tablespoons of oil. Add the rice, stir it in the oil and pour over the same amount of water as rice (or the amount stated on the packet). Season, cover the pan and cook over a medium heat for 8-10 minutes (or the time stated on the packet). Remove from the heat and transfer to a large bowl.

Beat 2 eggs, season them and add a little chopped parsley. Heat a frying pan with a little oil, pour in the beaten eggs and cook until you have a thin, round omelette. Make another omelette in the same way with the other 2 eggs. Dice the omelettes and add them to the bowl with the rice.

Cut the pancetta into small dice and sauté (until browned) in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil. Add it to the bowl and mix well.

Serve the rice with the lettuce and spring onion salad. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Risotto con panceta y pollo.elaboracion:
Dice the spring onion and the (peeled) pepper and fry gently for 8-10 minutes over a medium heat in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 3-4 tablespoons of oil.

Chop the pancetta, add it to the pan and fry until lightly browned. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, season with salt and pepper, add it and fry until browned.

Add the rice and saffron threads to the casserole. Stir briefly and pour over 500 ml of (hot) water. Season and stir often. As the rice absorbs the water, add another 500 ml of water. Repeat until the rice is done (about 18 minutes). Add the cheese and stir until melted.

Serve the risotto and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Risotto de champiñones con solomillo de.elaboracion:
Peel the onion and garlic cloves, cut them into small dice and fry gently for 6-8 minutes in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 3-4 tablespoons of oil.

Cut the green garlic into 1 cm slices, add it to the casserole and cook for 2 minutes. Wash the mushrooms, quarter them and add them. Season and cook for 4-5 minutes. Pour over the brandy and boil hard until the alcohol has evaporated.

Add the rice, stir it for a moment and add half the stock. Cook, stirring often, until the stock is absorbed. Pour in more stock and repeat until the rice is done (about 18 minutes in total).

Cut the pork tenderloin into bite-sized pieces, season with salt and pepper and fry them in a frying pan with 2-3 tablespoons of oil.

Divide the risotto between 4 plates and top with a few pieces of pork tenderloin. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Arroz familiar.elaboracion:
Dice the spring onion finely and fry gently in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 3 tablespoons of oil. Remove the stalk from the pepper, cut it into thin strips about 3 cm long and add it. Fry the vegetables gently for 6-8 minutes.

Season the chicken with salt and pepper, add it to the casserole and brown it lightly. Slice the chorizo, add it and fry briefly. Wash the tomato, cut it in half, grate it and add it. Add the saffron threads and the rice, stir briefly, pour over the stock and season. Cook the rice for 18 minutes. Remove from the heat and leave to rest for 2-3 minutes.

Serve the rice and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Paella valenciana.elaboracion:
Cut the chicken and rabbit into pieces, salt them and brown them well in the paella pan with the oil.

Push the meat to the edges, add the green beans and the garrofón (large white lima beans) and fry for 5 minutes. Add the grated tomato and the paprika and fry gently for a couple of minutes.

Pour in the water, add the saffron and rosemary and simmer for 25 minutes. Taste the stock and adjust the salt.

Spread the rice evenly across the paella pan and cook for 10 minutes over a high heat and 8 minutes over a low heat, without stirring. Leave to rest for 5 minutes covered with a cloth.

Arroz negro con sepia.elaboracion:
Clean the cuttlefish and dice it. Chop the onion, pepper and garlic.

Brown the cuttlefish in a paella pan with oil. Add the chopped vegetables and soften for 10 minutes. Add the grated tomato and fry gently until its liquid has evaporated.

Add the rice, stir for a minute and pour in the hot fish stock mixed with the squid ink. Season.

Cook for 18 minutes without stirring, over a high heat for the first few minutes and then over a low heat. Leave to rest for 5 minutes and serve with alioli.

Arroz con verduras de temporada.elaboracion:
Dice the courgette, aubergine, peppers and onion. Chop the trimmed artichokes and the mushrooms.

Fry the onion and peppers gently in a casserole with oil. Add the rest of the vegetables and sauté for 8 minutes.

Add the grated tomato and the paprika, stir and add the rice. Stir for a minute and pour in the hot stock with the saffron.

Cook for 18 minutes over a medium heat, without stirring. Leave to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Canelones a la boloñesa.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt it, add the cannelloni and cook for the time stated on the packet. Remove them, drain them and lay them on a clean tea towel.

Heat 3-4 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan. Peel the garlic cloves, cut them into small dice and add them. Peel the onion, dice it finely and add it. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it the same way and add it. Peel the carrots, cut them into quarter-moons and add them. Dice the celery stick finely and add it. Season and fry the vegetables gently for 10-12 minutes.

Add the minced meats, season with salt and pepper and fry them briefly.

Pour over the white wine and bring to the boil. Add the tomato, stir and cook the bolognese for 10-15 minutes.

Fill the cannelloni with the bolognese and divide them between 4 ovenproof plates (or one dish).

To make the béchamel, melt the butter in a saucepan, add the flour and cook it well. Add the milk a little at a time, stirring constantly, until well combined. Cook the béchamel over a low heat for 8-10 minutes. Season with salt, a pinch of nutmeg and the chopped parsley.

Cover the cannelloni with the béchamel sauce, sprinkle the cheese on top and grill until the cheese is golden. Serve and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Cintas con tomate y queso.nombre: Ribbon pasta with tomato and cheese
Cintas con tomate y queso.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a saucepan. Wash the tomatoes, score a shallow cross in the base, put them in the pan and blanch them for 2 minutes. Remove, peel and cut into small dice.

Peel the garlic cloves and cut each into 3 slices. Trim the bottom of the asparagus and cut into 1 cm pieces. Heat a large frying pan with 3 tablespoons of oil, add the garlic and asparagus and cook for 3-5 minutes over a low heat. Add the tomatoes, season, cook for 15 minutes over a medium heat and sprinkle with the oregano.

Heat plenty of water in a saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt the water, add the pasta ribbons and cook for the time stated on the packet. Lift them out and put them straight into the frying pan with the vegetables. Mix well and divide between 4 plates.

Sprinkle the plates with the cheese and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Espirales con sofrito y anchoas.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, add the pasta and salt. Cook for slightly less than the time stated on the packet (it should be very al dente).

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole). Clean the green garlic (trimming the bottom and top and removing 1 outer layer), cut it into 1 cm slices, add it to the casserole and fry gently over a low heat for 3-4 minutes.

Add the tomato and onion sofrito to the casserole. Cut the basil leaves into fine strips and add them. Cut 12 olives in half (reserve the rest) and add them. Cook everything together for 8-10 minutes.

Add the (drained) pasta to the sofrito, mix well and cook everything for 2-3 minutes.

Divide the pasta between 4 plates and grind a little pepper over the top. Place 4 anchovy fillets and 4 olives on top of each (for a special touch, you can wrap the anchovy fillets around the olives). Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Lasaña de hortalizas con queso.elaboracion:
Heat 6 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan. Dice the spring onions finely and add them. Peel the carrots, cut them into thin quarter-moons and add them. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, peel it, dice it finely and add it. Season and fry the vegetables gently for 6-8 minutes. Wash the courgette, cut it into thin half-moons and add it. Trim the base of the mushrooms, rinse them, dry them, cut them first in half and then into slices and add them to the pan. Season and cook everything together for 10-12 minutes more. Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and add them. Add the thyme too and cook everything together for 6-8 minutes more.

Heat plenty of water with a pinch of salt in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, add the lasagne sheets one at a time and cook them for the time stated on the packet. Once cooked, drain them and spread them out on a clean cloth to dry well.

To make the béchamel, heat the oil in a saucepan, add the flour and cook it for a moment. Pour in the milk a little at a time, stirring constantly, and cook the sauce for 6-8 minutes (it does not need to be very thick). Season it, grate a little nutmeg over it, add the chopped parsley, stir and set aside.

To assemble the lasagne, place in the base of an ovenproof dish 3 lasagne sheets, half the vegetables, 3 lasagne sheets, the rest of the vegetables and 3 lasagne sheets. Cover with the béchamel and pour the tomato sauce over the top in lines. Grate the cheese and sprinkle it over the whole surface of the lasagne.

Put the lasagne in the oven and grill until heated through and the cheese is golden.

Cut the lasagne into portions and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Fettuccini alfredo con salmón.elaboracion:
To make the Alfredo sauce, cut the butter into pieces and melt it (over a low heat) in a saucepan. Peel the garlic, chop it finely and add it to the pan. Pour over the cream and leave it to reduce over a low heat for 5-6 minutes. Gradually add the cheese and stir gently. Keep the sauce warm (over a low heat).

Heat plenty of water in a saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt it and add the fettuccine. Cook for the time stated on the packet (about 8 minutes).

Cut the salmon into small pieces, season with salt and pepper and sauté briefly (2-3 minutes) over a high heat in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil.

Drain the pasta (reserving a little of the cooking water), return it to the pan, pour over the Alfredo sauce and mix well.

Divide the pasta between 4 plates and top with a few pieces of salmon. Sprinkle the plates with a little chopped parsley and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Rigatoni con setas y pollo.nombre: Rigatoni with wild mushrooms and chicken
Rigatoni con setas y pollo.elaboracion:
Heat a frying pan with 4 tablespoons of oil. Peel 1 garlic clove, chop it and add it. Dice the chicken breast, season with salt and pepper, add it to the pan and sauté for 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Peel and chop the other garlic clove and add it to the pan. Add the mushrooms, season and sauté for 3-5 minutes. Transfer them to the plate with the chicken.

Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half and grate them. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to the pan in which you sautéed the chicken and mushrooms, pour in the wine and bring to the boil. Add the oregano and the (grated) tomato, season and cook for 12-13 minutes.

Heat plenty of water in a saucepan and salt it. When the water comes to the boil, add the rigatoni and cook for a little less than the time stated on the packet (they should be very al dente).

Lift the rigatoni out of the pan and add them to the frying pan with the tomato sauce. Add the chicken and mushrooms, stir and cook everything together for 3-4 minutes. Add a little chopped parsley and serve. Sprinkle the plates with a little grated cheese and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Pastel de macarrones y pollo.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, add the macaroni, salt and cook for 2 minutes less than stated on the packet. Remove, drain and set aside.

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan. Peel the onion, dice it finely and add it to the pan. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it the same way and add it. Season and cook the vegetables over a low heat for 10 minutes.

Remove the skin from the chicken thighs, dice the meat, season with salt and pepper, add it to the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes. Pour over the tomato sauce. Chop the basil leaves, add them and cook everything over a moderate heat for 3-4 minutes.

Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan, add the macaroni and a little chopped parsley and sauté for 3-4 minutes.

Line a round springform tin with a large piece of baking paper and fill it with the macaroni. Beat 4 eggs in a large bowl, add the cream and yoghurt and beat again until well combined. Pour the mixture over the macaroni and spread the meat on top. Sprinkle the surface with the grated cheese and bake at 180 ºC for about 35 minutes.

Take it out of the oven, leave it to cool slightly and unmould it. Cut into portions and serve. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Fideos a la cazuela con costilla.nombre: Noodle casserole with pork ribs (fideos a la cazuela)
Fideos a la cazuela con costilla.elaboracion:
Put 1.500 ml of water in a pressure cooker, add the ribs, season, close the cooker and cook for 5 minutes. Remove the ribs, take the meat off the bones, chop it a little and set aside. Strain the cooking stock and reserve it separately.

Peel the garlic and onions, cut them into small dice and fry gently in a tartera (a wide, shallow casserole) with 4 tablespoons of oil. When the vegetables are golden (10-15 minutes), add the rib meat and brown it lightly (3-4 minutes).

Cut the tomatoes in half, grate them, add them to the casserole and cook for 8-10 minutes. Add the pâté, the paprika and the cinnamon and mix well. Add the noodles and 400 ml of the reserved stock, season and cook for the time stated on the packet (11-13 minutes). During cooking, as they dry out, add a little more stock (about 200 ml).

Sprinkle the noodles with a little chopped parsley and serve. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Tallarines con panceta y queso.elaboracion:
Heat water in a saucepan and salt it. Add the peas and cook for 10-12 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Peel 1 garlic clove, chop it finely and fry gently in a saucepan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Dice the spring onion finely and add it. Fry everything gently for 8-10 minutes over a low heat. Add the tomato sauce and the drained peas. Season and cook the sauce for 6-8 minutes.

Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Peel the other 2 garlic cloves, slice them and add them. Brown them lightly, transfer to a plate and set aside. Dice the pancetta, season it, add it to the pan and brown it well. Remove it and leave to drain in a colander. Keep the pan for sautéing the tagliatelle.

Grate the cheese and set aside.

Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt it and add the tagliatelle. Cook for the time stated on the packet (about 2-3 minutes).

Add the tagliatelle (in two batches) to the pan in which you browned the pancetta, add a pinch of oregano (fresh or dried) and sauté briefly.

Spread the tomato and pea sauce over the base of the plates and top each with a portion of the sautéed pasta (twirled into a large nest with the help of a fork), some diced pancetta, a few slices of garlic and the grated cheese. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Tagliatelle a la carbonara.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt it and add the tagliatelle. Cook for 6-8 minutes (or the time stated on the packet). Remove and drain.

Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan. Peel the garlic cloves, slice them, add them to the pan and fry them gently for a moment. Cut the pancetta into thin strips, add it and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add the pasta to the pan and sauté briefly.

Put the egg yolks in a large bowl, season them, add the cheese and mix well. Add the tagliatelle and mix again until well combined.

Divide the pasta between 4 deep plates and grind a little pepper over each. Scatter the basil leaves over them and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Canelones de pescado y hortalizas.elaboracion:
The day before, leave the hake to thaw in the least cold part of the fridge.

Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. Add the cannelloni sheets, salt and cook for the time stated on the packet. Remove them, drain them on a clean tea towel and set aside.

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Dice the leeks finely and add them. Peel the carrots, cut them the same way and add them. Season and cook the vegetables for 6-8 minutes.

Cut the hake into small dice, season and add it to the pan. Add the tomato sauce, mix well and cook everything for 3-4 minutes. Set the filling aside.

To make the velouté sauce, heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan, add the flour and cook it well. Add the milk a little at a time and stir until combined. Pour in the fish stock and keep stirring until well combined. Season and cook the sauce over a low heat for 8-10 minutes, stirring constantly.

Add 1 ladleful of the velouté to the filling (reserve the rest) and mix well.

Fill the cannelloni and divide them between 4 (ovenproof) plates or place them all in one ovenproof dish. Cover with a thin layer of velouté, sprinkle with the cheese and grill until golden.

Serve and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Tallarines con jamón y panceta.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of water in a large saucepan. When it comes to the boil, salt it and add the tagliatelle. Cook for the time stated on the packet. Remove and drain. Reserve a little of the cooking water as well.

Peel the garlic cloves and slice them. Dice the ham and pancetta.

Heat a large frying pan (or wok) with 3 tablespoons of oil. Add the garlic, the chilli, the pancetta and the ham and sauté briefly. Add the tagliatelle and a little of the cooking water. Sauté briefly, sprinkle with a little chopped parsley and serve.

Espaguetis con tomate y albahaca.elaboracion:
Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water for the time stated on the packet.

Meanwhile, brown the sliced garlic in a frying pan with oil. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until softened.

Lightly crush the tomatoes, season and add the drained spaghetti with a splash of the cooking water. Sauté for a minute.

Serve topped with fresh basil leaves and grated Parmesan cheese.

Macarrones con chorizo gratinados.elaboracion:
Cook the macaroni in salted water and drain it one minute before the time stated on the packet.

Chop the onion and soften it in a frying pan with oil. Add the sliced chorizo and the mince and cook until browned.

Stir in the tomato sauce and the oregano, mix with the macaroni and transfer to an ovenproof dish.

Cover with the grated cheese and grill in the oven at 220 ºC for about 10 minutes, until the cheese is golden.

Fideuá.elaboracion:
Brown the noodles in a paella pan with a little oil, stirring so they toast evenly. Set them aside.

In the same pan, brown the squid pieces and the peeled prawns. Remove the prawns and add the garlic and grated tomato; fry gently for 5 minutes with the paprika.

Add the noodles, pour in the hot fish stock with the saffron and season. Cook for about 10 minutes over a medium heat until the stock has been absorbed.

Arrange the prawns on top, leave to rest for 3 minutes and serve with alioli.

Albóndigas con tomate y puré de patata.nombre: Meatballs in tomato sauce with mashed potato
Albóndigas con tomate y puré de patata.elaboracion:
Break the breadcrumb (the soft inside of the bread) into pieces and put it in a large bowl. Pour the wine over it and wait until the bread is well soaked. Drain it in a sieve and set aside.

Heat water in a saucepan and season it. Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces, add them to the pan and cook for 15-20 minutes. Drain them and pass them through a food mill (or mash them with a potato masher) into a bowl. Add the (hot) milk a little at a time and mix gently. Season with salt and pepper, add a little chopped parsley and mix again. Set the mash aside.

Put the mince (beef and pork) in a bowl. Peel 2 garlic cloves, chop them finely (into small dice) and add them together with the egg yolk and 1 teaspoon of chopped parsley. Season with salt and pepper and mix. Add the (drained) bread and keep mixing until everything is well combined. Shape into small balls, coat them in flour and fry them in a frying pan with oil.

Heat the tomato and onion sofrito in a shallow casserole, add the meatballs and cook for 5-6 minutes. If the sauce is too thick, you can thin it with a little water.

Cover the base of the plates with the mashed potato and serve the meatballs on top. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Albóndigas en salsa de almendras.elaboracion:
Break the breadcrumb (the soft inside of the bread) into pieces and put it in a bowl. Pour in the milk and wait until it is well soaked.

Put the meats (beef and pork) in a bowl and mix them. Peel 3 garlic cloves, chop them finely and add them. Also add the egg yolks, 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley, the juice of half a lemon, the drained bread, and salt and pepper (to taste). Mix well. Shape into small balls, coat them in flour and fry them in a frying pan with 150 ml of oil. Remove them and set aside on a dish.

Strain the oil left over from frying the meatballs, transfer it to another frying pan, add the almonds, toast them until golden and set them aside on a plate.

Peel the onion, dice it, add it to the pan and soften for 8-10 minutes.

Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half and grate them. Add the tomato pulp, 1 teaspoon of sugar, the cumin, the pepper and the bay leaf to the pan. Cook for 8-10 minutes.

Add the almonds and the white wine. Season and cook everything for 15 minutes over a low heat. Remove the bay leaf and blend the mixture in a blender.

Put the meatballs in the pan, pour the sauce over them (if it is too thick, you can thin it with a little hot water) and cook for 6-8 minutes.

Aleta rellena de pimientos y tortilla.nombre: Beef flank stuffed with peppers and omelette
Aleta rellena de pimientos y tortilla.elaboracion:
Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Heat a frying pan with 1 teaspoon of oil, pour in the eggs and cook on both sides to make a thin omelette. Transfer it to a plate and set aside.

Lay the (butterflied) flank out on a board, season with salt and pepper and place the omelette and the peppers (opened in half) on top. Season the peppers, roll up the flank and tie it with kitchen string. Season the outside and brown it in a frying pan with a splash of oil for 3-4 minutes. Transfer the flank to an ovenproof dish.

Peel the garlic, onion and carrots and dice them. Sauté the vegetables for 2 minutes in the same pan in which you browned the meat. Add the wine and bring to the boil. Add the vegetables to the dish with the flank and roast at 190-200 ºC for 35-40 minutes.

Remove the meat, leave it to cool slightly, slice it and set aside. Transfer the vegetables to a blender jug and blend with a hand blender. Set the sauce aside.

Trim the Brussels sprouts (removing the outer leaves) and cut them in half. Heat a frying pan with 3-4 tablespoons of oil, add the Brussels sprouts, season and cook over a low-medium heat for 6-8 minutes.

Serve 2 slices of flank, 4 Brussels sprouts (8 halves) and a little sauce on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Brochetas de pollo con salsa teriyaki.elaboracion:
To make the teriyaki sauce, put the soy sauce, sugar, sake, mirin, cornflour mixed with a little cold water, ginger and spring onion greens (sliced) in a small saucepan. Heat over a low heat for 5 minutes (until thickened). Strain the sauce into a bowl and set aside.

Put the minced chicken in a bowl. Trim the bottom and top of the leek and remove 2-3 outer leaves, rinse it, chop it finely and add it to the bowl. Peel the ginger, grate it and add it. Add the egg and the breadcrumbs. Season with salt and pepper and mix well until smooth. Cover the bowl with cling film and leave to rest in the fridge for 1 hour.

Take a portion of meat, roll it into a ball and then shape it into an elongated form (like a long croquette). Push a skewer into the centre (like an ice lolly) and set aside. Repeat with the rest of the meat to make 12 skewers. Drizzle them with a little oil and cook them on a griddle.

Clean the endive, dry it, tear it into pieces and put it in a bowl. Dress it with oil, vinegar and salt.

Serve the chicken skewers, drizzle them with the teriyaki sauce and accompany them with a little salad. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Carrilleras de ternera con pastel de pat.elaboracion:
To make the potato cake, peel the potatoes, slice them very thinly (to get even slices, you can use a mandoline), and cut the pancetta rashers in half.

Grease the base of an (ovenproof) tin with butter, lay a layer of potatoes on top, season with a pinch of salt, dot with a little more butter, sprinkle with a little grated cheese, add another layer of potatoes, season with another pinch of salt, spread with butter, add a little more cheese and finally lay the pancetta rashers on top. Finish assembling the cake by alternating layers of potato, butter and cheese until all the ingredients are used up. Bake the cake at 180 ºC for 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and drain off the excess fat.

Remove the membrane covering the cheeks and season with salt and pepper. Heat 3-4 tablespoons of oil in a pressure cooker, add the cheeks and brown them well on both sides. Remove them and set aside on a plate.

Peel the garlic cloves, onion and carrot. Dice everything and add to the pressure cooker. Soften the vegetables for 10-12 minutes. Return the cheeks to the pressure cooker and add the wines (red and port), the thyme, the bay leaf and 200 ml of water. Adjust the salt, close the pressure cooker and cook the cheeks for 40 minutes.

Remove the cheeks, blend the sauce (if it is too thin, bring it to the boil and thicken it with a little cornflour mixed with cold water) and add a little chopped parsley.

Slice the cheeks, serve 3-4 slices on each plate and spoon over the sauce. Cut the potato cake into 4 portions and place one on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Crepes de pavo, puerro y queso.elaboracion:
Cook the turkey breast in a saucepan with water and a pinch of salt for 15-20 minutes. Once cooked, transfer it to a plate, leave it to cool slightly, shred it and set aside.

Peel the carrots and slice them thinly. Cook them for 8-10 minutes in a saucepan of boiling water seasoned with a pinch of salt. Transfer them to a blender jug, add the cream and blend with a hand blender (if it is too thick, add a little of the carrot cooking water until it has the consistency of a cream soup). Set the carrot cream aside.

To make the crêpe batter, crack the eggs into a blender jug and add the milk, flour, a pinch of salt and the oil. Blend with a hand blender until smooth.

Heat a frying pan with 1 teaspoon of oil and spread it well. Pour in a little batter, spread it over the whole base of the pan and wait until it sets slightly; turn it over and cook briefly (if it comes out too greasy, discard it). Repeat until all the batter is used up.

Clean the leeks, trimming the bottom and top and removing the outer layer, rinse them, cut them into pieces about 5-6 centimetres long and then into fine julienne strips. Peel the garlic cloves, chop them finely and soften them in a frying pan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Add the leeks, season and cook over a low-medium heat for 6-8 minutes.

Grate the cheese and set it aside.

Fill the crêpes with the leeks, turkey and cheese and roll them up.

Serve a little carrot cream and 2 crêpes on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Guiso de pollo y costillas con patatas y.nombre: Chicken and pork rib stew with potatoes and rice omelette
Guiso de pollo y costillas con patatas y.elaboracion:
Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a large casserole. Season the chicken and the ribs, add them and fry them for a while until golden. Grate the onion and add it. Stir and continue to soften over a low heat for 5 minutes.

Wash the tomato, cut it in half, grate it and add it. Peel the red pepper and cut it into strips. Peel the carrots and slice them. Wash the green beans, top and tail them and cut them in half. Add the vegetables to the stew.

Peel the potatoes, break them into pieces (snapping them rather than cutting cleanly) and add them to the casserole.

Add the paprika, saffron and bay leaf, season and cover everything with water (1,500-2,000 ml).

Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat them. Add the rice and a pinch of salt and mix well. Heat a splash of oil in a frying pan, add the beaten eggs with the rice and cook the omelette on both sides.

Place the omelette on top of the stew, cover the casserole and cook everything together for about 35 minutes.

Serve and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Guiso de jarretes de cordero con arroz.elaboracion:
Peel 2 garlic cloves, crush them with the flat of a knife, chop them roughly and put them in a mortar. Chop the rosemary and thyme and add them. Season and pound everything. Add 5-6 tablespoons of oil and mix well.

Season the shanks and place them in a dish. Pour the herb paste over them, rub it in well and leave them to rest for at least 30 minutes (better still, marinate them overnight).

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pressure cooker. Peel the onions, dice them and add them to the pressure cooker. Peel the carrots, cut them into quarter-moons and add them. Wash the mushrooms, quarter them and add them. Season and cook the vegetables for about 15 minutes.

Remove the shanks from the herb paste (set it aside) and brown them well in a large frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil.

Put the shanks in the pressure cooker and add the herb paste, tomato purée, wine and stock. Adjust the salt, close the pressure cooker and cook for 30-35 minutes. Remove the shanks from the pressure cooker and blend the vegetables with a hand blender. Transfer the sauce to a wide, shallow casserole and add the shanks.

Heat a saucepan with 1 tablespoon of oil. Crush the other 2 garlic cloves (unpeeled) with the flat of the knife and add them. Add the rice and the water (the same amount as the rice), season, cover the pan and cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes.

Serve one shank on each plate, spoon over the sauce and accompany with a portion of rice. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Moussaka de cordero.elaboracion:
Wash the aubergines and, using a mandoline, cut them lengthways into ½ cm slices. Sprinkle a dish with a little salt, lay the aubergine slices in it and season the tops. Repeat until all are used. Leave them for 30 minutes to release some of their water (you can tilt the dish so the water collects at the lower end).

Peel the potatoes and, using the mandoline, cut them into 1 cm slices. Heat plenty of oil in a frying pan, add the potatoes and fry them (in batches) on both sides. Remove them and drain on a dish lined with kitchen paper.

Pat the aubergine slices dry and fry them (in batches) in the same pan in which you fried the potatoes. Remove them and drain on another dish lined with kitchen paper.

Heat 3-4 tablespoons of oil (you can use the oil left over from frying the potatoes and aubergines) in a wide, shallow casserole. Peel the garlic and onion, cut them into small dice and add them to the casserole. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, cut it in the same way and add it. Soften the vegetables for 6-8 minutes.

Add the minced lamb, thyme, rosemary and oregano. Season with salt and pepper, mix well and cook over a high heat for 2 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and cook the meat filling for 8-10 minutes.

To make the béchamel, heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan, add the flour and cook it briefly. Add the milk a little at a time and cook, stirring constantly, for 8-10 minutes. Season, grate over a little nutmeg and mix well.

Assemble the moussaka in an ovenproof dish, starting with a layer of potatoes on the base. Top with a layer of aubergine, then one of meat, another of aubergine and, finally, one of béchamel. Sprinkle the surface with the grated cheese, put the dish in the oven and bake the moussaka at 180 ºC for 15-20 minutes.

Serve and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Pavo en salsa con patatas fritas.elaboracion:
Season the turkey thighs with salt and pepper and brown them for 3-4 minutes in a pressure cooker with 2-3 tablespoons of oil. Also add the cayenne chilli.

Peel the garlic cloves, cut them in half and add them. Pour in the wine and bring to the boil.

Put the peppers in a blender jug, add 100 ml of water and blend. Add the purée to the pressure cooker. Pour another 100 ml of water into the jug, swirl it round (to pick up the purée left in the jug) and add it to the stew. Also add the peppercorns and the sprigs of thyme and rosemary, adjust the salt and close the pressure cooker. Cook the turkey for 13 minutes.

Peel the potatoes, dice them and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of oil. Remove them and drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper. Season them and sprinkle with a little chopped parsley.

When ready to serve, remove the turkey thighs and divide them between 4 plates. To thicken the sauce, add a little cornflour mixed with cold water and bring to the boil until it thickens.

Spoon the sauce over the plates and scatter the potatoes on top. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Sarmale.elaboracion:
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Peel the onion, cut it into small dice, add it to the pan, season and cook for 6-8 (until it starts to turn translucent). Add the rice and fry for a couple of minutes. Transfer to a plate and leave to cool.

Put the meats in a bowl, season with salt and pepper, add the paprika and thyme and mix well. Add the rice and onion and mix again until everything is well combined. Take small portions of meat (45-50 g), shape them into croquettes and set aside.

Cut the cabbage leaves in half and remove the thickest part of the central rib. Lay half a leaf on a flat surface (worktop or board), place a portion of meat on it (to one side of the leaf) and wrap it in the cabbage leaf to form a roll (it is important to fold the sides inwards so the meat does not escape). Repeat until all the ingredients (meat and cabbage leaves) are used up.

Transfer the sarmale to a wide casserole, add the crushed tomatoes and cover with water (approx. 1,500 ml). Season, cover and cook for 90 minutes over a low heat.

Heat water in a saucepan. When it starts to boil, add the polenta, season, cook for 4-5 minutes, transfer to a dish and leave to cool.

Divide the sarmale and polenta between 6 plates and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Ternera guisada con setas.elaboracion:
Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a pressure cooker. Peel the onion, dice it and add it to the pressure cooker. Wash the pepper, remove the stalk and seeds, dice it and add it. Clean the leek, trimming the bottom and top and removing the outer layer, rinse it, dice it and add it. Peel the carrot, dice it and add it. Peel the garlic cloves and add them whole. Season and soften the vegetables for 8-10 minutes.

Heat a frying pan with 3-4 tablespoons of oil. Season the pieces of meat and add half to the pan. Brown them over a high heat, transfer them to a plate and set aside. Repeat with the rest of the meat.

Put the meat in the pressure cooker. Grate the tomato over it and pour in the cider and about 500 ml of water (enough to cover the meat). Season and add the rosemary, thyme and peppercorns. Close the pressure cooker and cook for 15 minutes. Remove the herbs, transfer the meat to a wide, shallow casserole and blend the sauce with a hand blender. Strain the sauce and pour it over the meat.

Peel the potatoes, dice them and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of oil. Remove them, drain, season, sprinkle with a little chopped parsley and add them to the casserole.

Pour off some of the oil used for frying the potatoes. Clean the ceps, slice them and add them to the pan. Season and sauté for 3-4 minutes. Add them to the casserole.

Divide the stew between 6 plates and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Lagarto con patatas hasselback.nombre: Iberian pork lagarto with hasselback potatoes
Lagarto con patatas hasselback.elaboracion:
Put the sugar and the Pedro Ximénez in a small saucepan and reduce over a low heat for about 15-20 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and leave to cool.

Wash the potatoes well and dry them. Make parallel cuts (½ cm apart) without cutting right through to the base (to do this, you can set the potato in a container with a low rim, or between 2 chopsticks; the rim stops the knife from reaching the bottom so the slices stay joined at the base).

Put the potatoes in an ovenproof dish, open them out slightly, season them and drizzle with a splash of oil. Put a knob of butter on each one. Chop the thyme finely and sprinkle it over them. Roast at 180-200 ºC for 40 minutes (if they are browning too much, you can cover them with a piece of foil).

Dice the spring onion and soften it for 4-5 minutes in a frying pan with 2-3 tablespoons of oil. Add the flour and cook it briefly. Pour in the meat stock and the Pedro Ximénez reduction. Chop the rosemary finely and add it. Season and cook the mixture over a low heat for 4-5 minutes.

Heat a frying pan with 3-4 tablespoons of oil. Season the lagarto strips with salt and pepper, put half of them in the pan, fry them briefly on both sides and transfer to a plate. Fry the rest of the meat in the same way and transfer to the plate.

Pour the fat out of the pan, put all the lagarto strips back in, add the sauce, turn off the heat and stir until they are well coated in the sauce.

Serve a few lagarto strips and 1 hasselback potato on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Albóndigas de pollo con salsa de mango y.nombre: Chicken meatballs with mango and curry sauce
Albóndigas de pollo con salsa de mango y.elaboracion:
Chop the chicken with a knife (or put it through a mincer) and put it in a bowl. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, egg and grated cheese, season with salt and pepper and mix well. Add the breadcrumbs a little at a time and keep mixing until everything is well combined. Cover the bowl with cling film, put it in the fridge and leave the mixture to rest for about 30 minutes.

Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a casserole. Dice the spring onion, add it and soften for about 5 minutes. Peel the mangoes, chop them and add them. Add the curry powder and the cream and adjust the salt. Cook over a low-medium heat for 20 minutes. Blend with a hand blender until you have a smooth sauce and set aside.

Take the meatball mixture out of the fridge, take small portions, roll them into balls, coat them in flour and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of hot oil (about 200 ml). Remove them and drain on a dish lined with kitchen paper.

Put the meatballs in a wide, shallow casserole, pour the sauce over them and cook for 5 minutes over a low heat.

Serve and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Pollo al ajillo.elaboracion:
Cut the chicken into small pieces, season and brown well on all sides in a casserole with oil.

Add the whole garlic cloves, lightly crushed so they split open, and the bay leaf. Cook for 5 minutes over a low heat so the garlic cooks without burning.

Pour in the white wine, let the alcohol evaporate and cover. Cook for a further 20 minutes, stirring from time to time.

Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with chips or a salad.

Solomillo de cerdo a la pimienta.elaboracion:
Cut the tenderloin into medallions two fingers thick and season with salt.

Sear them in a frying pan with very hot oil, 2 minutes on each side. Remove and set aside.

In the same pan, brown the chopped shallot, add the crushed peppercorns and flambé with the brandy. Add the cream and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.

Return the medallions to the sauce, cook for a further 2 minutes and serve.

Estofado de ternera con patatas.elaboracion:
Cut the beef into chunks, season and brown them in a pot with oil. Remove them.

In the same pot, soften the chopped onion, garlic, pepper and carrot for 10 minutes. Add the grated tomato and fry gently for a further 5 minutes.

Return the meat to the pot, pour in the red wine and let it reduce. Cover with the stock, add the bay leaf and thyme and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 1½ hours.

Add the potatoes in chunks and cook for a further 25 minutes, until tender. Check the seasoning and serve.

Bacalao a la riojana con guindillas frit.nombre: Rioja-style cod with fried green chillies
Bacalao a la riojana con guindillas frit.elaboracion:
Peel the garlic, slice it and soften it in a frying pan with 4-5 tablespoons of oil. Peel the onions, cut them into large dice and add them. Peel the peppers, remove the stalks and seeds, cut them into large dice and add them to the pan. Season and cook the vegetables for about 10 minutes.

Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half, grate them and add them to the pan. Cook everything for 15-20 minutes.

Cut each cod loin in two and add them to the pan (skin side up first). Cook over a low heat for 5 minutes on each side.

Fry the green chillies in a frying pan with very hot oil. Transfer them to a plate and season.

Serve a piece of cod with its sauce on each plate, accompanied by the fried chillies. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.
