Bacalao gratinado con mayonesa de ajo fr.nombre: Cod gratin with green garlic mayonnaise
Bacalao gratinado con mayonesa de ajo fr.elaboracion:
Mix 2 glasses of water and the paprika in a bowl. Place the slices of bread in a deep dish, pour the water and paprika mixture over them and leave them to stand until they have absorbed all the liquid.

Place each slice between two plates and press them until well drained. Line a baking tray with baking paper, lay the bread slices on top, cover them with another sheet of baking paper and weigh them down with another baking tray on top. Bake at 180 ºC for 25-30 minutes. Remove and set aside.

Chop 8 green garlic shoots (set the rest aside) and cook them over a low heat in a frying pan with 4 tablespoons of oil until soft (about 10 minutes), transfer them to a mortar and pound well to a garlic cream. Set aside.

To make the mayonnaise, crack the egg into a blender jug and add the vinegar, a pinch of salt and 250 ml of oil. Push the hand blender right to the bottom and start blending without moving it. When it starts to emulsify, move it gently. Add the green garlic cream with its oil and keep blending until you have a smooth sauce. Set the mayonnaise aside.

Cut the cod into 8 pieces, flatten them with a knife (giving them a few taps), season, coat in flour and fry briefly (1 minute on each side) in a frying pan with 8 tablespoons of hot oil. Remove them and place them on a baking tray. Cover each piece with a little green garlic mayonnaise and grill for 2-3 minutes (until golden).

Clean the rest of the green garlic, cut the shoots in half and make two lengthways cuts in each without cutting right through (as you would to clean leeks). Mix the tempura flour with very cold water (in the proportions stated on the packet). Dip the garlic shoots in the batter and fry them in a frying pan with very hot oil. Remove them and drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper.

Serve 2 pieces of cod, 4 green garlic tempura shoots and 1 slice of paprika bread on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Brocheta de salmón con salsa de yogur.elaboracion:
Gently heat the oil in a small frying pan. Slice the spring onion greens and add them. Peel the garlic clove and add it. Add the thyme, dill and peppercorns. Cook over a very low heat for 10-12 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and leave to cool slightly. Strain the oil into a large rectangular container.

Trim the salmon, cut it into 16 large cubes and thread them, 4 at a time, onto 4 skewers. Place the skewers in the container and coat them well in the oil. Leave them to marinate for at least 1 hour (better still, overnight).

To make the yoghurt sauce, peel the shallot, cut it into small dice and put it in a bowl. Add the mayonnaise, yoghurt, a few drops of lemon juice, a pinch of salt and half of the chives, finely chopped.

Heat a griddle, place the salmon skewers on it and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side (depending on how you like it done). Remove them and season with salt and pepper.

Serve one skewer per portion, accompanied by the yoghurt sauce. Chop the remaining chives and sprinkle them over the sauce. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Bacalao fresco con cuscús.elaboracion:
Put the cod bones, the fennel stalks and a few sprigs of parsley in a saucepan with 500 ml of water. Season and cook for 10 minutes. Strain the stock and set aside.

Peel the spring onion and the carrot, dice them and soften them in a saucepan with 3 tablespoons of oil. Cut the fennel in the same way and add it. Season and soften the vegetables for about 10-12 minutes.

Add the couscous and the same volume of stock as couscous (set the rest aside). Cover the pan, remove it from the heat and leave the couscous to absorb the liquid. Add a little chopped parsley.

Put the rest of the stock in a saucepan. Season the cod loins with salt and pepper, place them in a steamer basket and set it over the pan. Cover and cook the fish for 6-8 minutes.

Using a ring mould, divide the couscous between 4 plates, place the pieces of cod on top and drizzle with a splash of oil. Garnish with a few fennel fronds.

Hamburguesa de salmón.elaboracion:
Cut the spring onion into rings, dust them with flour and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of hot oil (150 ml). Remove them, drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper and set aside.

Finely chop the fresh salmon, smoked salmon and gherkins and put them in a bowl. Season and mix well. Shape into 4 burgers and set aside.

Heat a frying pan with 1 tablespoon of oil, add the burgers and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side. Sprinkle the burgers with a few drops of lemon juice and transfer them to a dish.

Split the buns and toast the cut sides in a frying pan. Spread them with mayonnaise and fill them with the lettuce leaves, tomato slices and burgers.

Serve a burger and a few onion rings on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Gulas al ajillo con huevo flor.nombre: Garlic gulas (mock baby eels) with flower eggs
Gulas al ajillo con huevo flor.elaboracion:
Cut a large piece of cling film, lay it over a small bowl and pour a few drops of oil into it. Crack an egg on top, season it and sprinkle with a little chopped parsley. Twist the film around the egg and close it by tying it with a piece of kitchen string. Repeat with the rest of the eggs and set aside.

Heat water in a saucepan. When it starts to boil, lower the heat, add the eggs and cook for 3-4 minutes. Transfer them to a plate and, when ready to serve, cut and remove the film.

Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan. Peel the garlic cloves, slice them and add them to the pan. Also add the chilli and let everything brown a little. Remove the garlic and chilli to a plate and set aside.

Add the gulas to the pan and sauté briefly (1-2 minutes).

Divide the gulas between 4 plates and add 1 flower egg and a few garlic slices to each. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Salmonete en costra de hojaldre con espá.nombre: Red mullet in puff pastry with asparagus
Salmonete en costra de hojaldre con espá.elaboracion:
To make the sauce, heat the oil in a small saucepan. Peel the shallots, cut them into small dice, add them and season. Chop the dill finely and add it together with the tarragon. Add the vermouth and bring to the boil to evaporate the alcohol. Add the cream and cook the sauce for 5 minutes. Set aside.

With a sharp knife, fillet the red mullet (removing the head and backbone), season the fillets with salt and pepper and put them together in pairs.

Roll the puff pastry sheets out on the board, place 1 red mullet (2 fillets) on one side of the pastry and trim it leaving a border of about 3 cm all round. Cut another piece of pastry (slightly larger than the fish) and cover the fish with it. Press the edges of the pastry (top and bottom) together so they stick and cut it into the shape of a fish with a tail. With the back of a knife blade, mark out the shape of the head and place 1 peppercorn as an eye. Mark the scales with a piping nozzle. Place the fish on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Repeat with the rest of the red mullet and pastry. Beat the egg in a bowl and brush it over the top of the pastry. Bake the red mullet at 200 ºC for 20 minutes.

Wash the asparagus, trim off the woody ends and cut the spears in half. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the asparagus, season and sauté for 4-5 minutes.

Serve 2 red mullet, a portion of asparagus and a little sauce on each plate. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Merluza a la sidra con patatas.elaboracion:
Peel the garlic cloves and the onion, dice them and soften them over a medium-low heat in a casserole with 3 tablespoons of oil for 4-5 minutes. Peel the apple, chop it, add it, season and cook for 4 minutes. Add the paprika, tomato sauce and cider and cook everything over a low-medium heat for 15-20 minutes. Blend with a hand blender until you have a smooth sauce and set aside.

Peel the potatoes, cut them into ½ centimetre slices and fry them in a frying pan with plenty of hot oil until tender and lightly golden. Remove them, drain and arrange them over the base of a wide, shallow casserole. Add the sauce and cook the potatoes over a low heat for 4-5 minutes.

Season the pieces of hake with salt and pepper, coat them in flour and fry them briefly (30 seconds on each side) in the same pan in which you fried the potatoes. Remove them, drain and add them to the casserole. Pour in the fish stock (until you reach the consistency you want) and cook everything together for 2-3 minutes.

Divide the hake and potatoes between 4 plates and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Rape al vapor con crema de calabaza.elaboracion:
For the pumpkin cream, heat 250 ml of water and the milk in a saucepan. Peel the potato, chop it and add it. Peel the pumpkin, dice it and add it. Season and cook for 10-12 minutes. Blend everything with a hand blender and set the cream aside.

Heat a little water in a wide, shallow casserole. Season it and add a few sprigs of parsley. Cut the monkfish loins into 8 medallions, season with salt and pepper and place them in a steamer basket lined with a piece of baking paper. Cover the steamer and set it in the casserole. Cook the monkfish for about 6-8 minutes.

Peel the artichokes, removing 2-3 layers of leaves, and trim off the tops. Cut them into 6-8 wedges. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the artichokes, season and cook for 4-5 minutes.

To make the vinaigrette, chop the pistachios finely and put them in a bowl. Add the vinegar, oil and chopped parsley and mix well.

Spoon a little pumpkin cream onto the base of the plates, place 2 monkfish medallions on each, dress them with a little vinaigrette and add a few artichoke wedges. Sprinkle the plates with the paprika and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Salmón al limón con borraja.elaboracion:
Cut the borage into 3 centimetre pieces, wash it and cook it for 10 minutes in a saucepan of boiling water with a pinch of salt. Drain and set aside.

To make the sauce, melt the butter in a small saucepan and add the oil. Peel the garlic cloves, dice them and add them. Cut the spring onion in the same way and add it. Add the bay leaf, wine, mustard and cream and let the sauce reduce for 10 minutes. Strain it and heat it in a small saucepan. Squeeze the lemons, pour the juice into a bowl, add the cornflour mixed with cold water, mix well and pour the mixture into the pan. Bring to the boil until it thickens.

Season the salmon loins with salt and pepper and cook them on a griddle (skin side up first) for 4 minutes (2 on each side).

Heat a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil, add the borage and sauté briefly.

Spoon a little lemon sauce onto the base of 4 plates, place the salmon on top and the borage alongside. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Salmón cajún al horno.elaboracion:
To make the Cajun sauce, put the onion, cayenne, paprika, salt, sugar, thyme, oregano and lemon zest in a blender (blender jug or food processor). Blitz everything to a coarse powder. Peel the garlic cloves, chop them and add them to the blender. Also add the vinegar, oil and mustard. Blend again to a paste and transfer it to a small bowl.

Line a baking tray with baking paper. Spread the Cajun sauce over the salmon loins, place them on the tray and bake at 220 ºC for 8 minutes.

Dress the lamb's lettuce with oil and salt and divide it between 4 plates. Place 1 salmon loin on each and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Bacalao a la tranca.elaboracion:
Put the pepper in an ovenproof dish. Drizzle it with a splash of oil, season and roast at 190 ºC for 35-40 minutes. Remove it, leave it to cool slightly, remove the stalk and seeds, peel it, cut it into strips and set aside.

Put the potato (washed and unpeeled) in a pressure cooker, cover with water, close the pressure cooker and cook for 8-10 minutes. Remove it, leave it to cool slightly, peel it and set aside.

Heat water in a small saucepan, add the egg and cook for 10 minutes (counted from when the water starts to boil). Cool it in cold water, peel it, cut it into small dice, sprinkle with a little chopped parsley and set aside.

Heat 6-8 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan. Peel 1 garlic clove and add it. Dust the cod loins with flour, put them in the pan and fry them for 3 minutes on each side (until golden). Remove them and transfer to a plate. Also remove the garlic clove.

Leave 1-2 tablespoons of the oil in which you fried the cod in the pan and set the rest aside. Return the pan to the heat. Peel the other 2 garlic cloves, slice them and add them. Add the paprika, the pepper strips and 225 ml of fish stock (set the rest aside). Cook everything over a low-medium heat for 8-10 minutes.

Add 1-2 tablespoons of vinegar and the cod loins (skin side up) to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes.

Chop the cooked potato and put it in a blender jug. Add 2 tablespoons of the reserved oil and the rest of the stock (75 ml). Blend with a hand blender until you have a smooth purée.

Spoon the potato purée onto the base of the plates, place 1 cod loin and a few strips of pepper on each and sprinkle with the chopped egg. Garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Atún con puré de patata y cebolla.nombre: Tuna with potato and onion purée
Atún con puré de patata y cebolla.elaboracion:
Heat plenty of oil (150 ml) in a frying pan. Peel the garlic cloves, slice them and add them to the pan. Peel the onions, dice them and add them. Peel the potatoes, cut them into thin quarter-moons and add them. Season and cook everything over a low heat for 15-20 minutes.

Drain the vegetables (keep the oil in a bowl) and put them in a blender. Add the milk and blend until you have a smooth purée. Set aside.

Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil (you can use the oil left over from frying the potatoes) in a frying pan, add the peppers and fry them for 5-6 minutes over a low-medium heat. Season and set aside.

Cut the tuna into 8-12 steaks, season with salt and pepper and fry them briefly (1 minute on each side) in a frying pan with 3-4 tablespoons of oil (you can use the oil left over from frying the potatoes). Transfer the tuna to a dish.

Add the vinegar and 1 teaspoon of chopped parsley to the pan in which you cooked the tuna and mix well.

Serve 3 peppers, a portion of potato purée and 2-3 tuna steaks on each plate. Spoon over the sauce and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Brocheta de bonito con salsa teriyaki y.nombre: Bonito skewers with teriyaki sauce and green chillies
Brocheta de bonito con salsa teriyaki y.elaboracion:
Put 4 skewer sticks in a jug or tall glass of water and leave them to soak for 30 minutes. Remove the sticks from the water, brush them with oil and set aside. To make the teriyaki sauce, put the soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar and cornflour in a saucepan. Mix well until the ingredients are fully combined. Peel the ginger, cut 6 thin slices and add them. Thinly slice the spring onion stalk and add it. Cook the ingredients for 4-5 minutes. Strain the sauce into a bowl and set aside.

Cut the bonito into 24 chunks. Season them with salt and pepper, thread 6 chunks onto each stick and drizzle the skewers with a little oil.

Heat a griddle, place the skewers on it and cook them briefly (2-3 minutes).

Heat 5-6 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, add the green chillies and fry them for 3-5 minutes. Transfer them to a serving dish and season them.

Serve 1 skewer on each plate and dress with the teriyaki sauce. Divide the chillies between the 4 plates and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Calamares a la romana.nombre: Calamares a la romana (battered squid rings)
Calamares a la romana.elaboracion:
For the orly batter, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them with an electric whisk. Add the flour and the baking powder and whisk again. Season, add the sparkling water and finish whisking the batter. Leave it to rest while you prepare the squid.

Separate the head from the body of the squid, remove the quill and the fins (also removing the skin) from the body, turn it inside out and rinse it well inside and out. Remove the beak from the head, separate the tentacles and the collar and rinse everything well. Cut the body into rings, the tentacles in pairs and the fins into strips. Season the squid, dip it in the orly batter, coat it well, let the excess drip off and fry it briefly in a frying pan with plenty of hot oil. Remove and drain on a plate lined with kitchen paper.

Serve the calamares a la romana with a few lemon wedges. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Merluza en salsa verde.elaboracion:
Season the hake steaks. Gently brown the chopped garlic in the oil in an earthenware casserole over a low heat.

Add the flour and stir for one minute. Pour in the white wine and the fish stock little by little, shaking the casserole so that the sauce emulsifies.

Add the hake and the clams and cook for 5-6 minutes, swirling the casserole back and forth. Turn the hake halfway through.

When the clams open, sprinkle with plenty of chopped parsley and serve.

Lubina al horno con patatas panaderas.nombre: Baked sea bass with baker's potatoes
Lubina al horno con patatas panaderas.elaboracion:
Preheat the oven to 180 ºC. Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices. Cut the onion and the pepper into thin strips.

Place the potatoes, onion and pepper in a baking tray, season, drizzle with oil and bake for 25 minutes.

Place the cleaned sea bass on top of the potatoes, with lemon slices inside. Season, drizzle with the white wine and bake for a further 15-20 minutes.

Brown the sliced garlic in a frying pan with oil, add a splash of vinegar off the heat and pour this garlic dressing over the fish when serving.

Mejillones a la marinera.elaboracion:
Clean the mussels thoroughly and remove their beards. Steam them open in a covered pan with the bay leaf and a little water. Strain the cooking liquid and set it aside.

Chop the onion and garlic and soften them in a frying pan with oil. Add the paprika and the crushed tomato and cook for 10 minutes.

Pour in the white wine and a little of the mussel liquid and leave to reduce for 5 minutes.

Add the mussels, stir so they are coated in the sauce and serve with chopped parsley.

Flan de chocolate con nata.elaboracion:
To make the caramel, heat the sugar in a frying pan. Wait until it melts and turns lightly golden. Pour it into a flan mould (with a lid) and spread it (taking care not to burn yourself) over the base and the lower part of the sides of the mould. Leave it to cool slightly.

Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the condensed milk and beat well with a hand whisk.

Put the cocoa and the milk in a blender jug and blend them with a hand blender. Add the cocoa milk to the bowl of eggs and condensed milk and mix well. Pour the mixture into the flan mould and put the lid on.

Pour a little water (2 fingers deep) into a pressure cooker, put the flan mould in it and cook the flan for 4 minutes.

When the valve drops, open the pressure cooker, remove the flan and wait until it is warm. Turn it out and serve. Decorate with the whipped cream, the raspberries and the mint leaves.

Tarta de galletas y chocolate con macada.nombre: Biscuit and chocolate cake with macadamia nuts
Tarta de galletas y chocolate con macada.elaboracion:
Lay a strip of baking paper along a rectangular (loaf) tin so that a flap sticks out at each end.

Spread the biscuits out on a large dish, pour the milk over them, grate a little orange zest over them and leave them to soak well.

Heat the cream in a saucepan. Add the chopped chocolate and stir gently until it melts. Turn off the heat, add the cheese and stir until it is combined into the mixture.

Cover the base of the tin with some of the chocolate, cream and cheese mixture. Lay 5 biscuits on top, cover them with a little more of the chocolate cream and top with another layer of biscuits. Repeat until all the ingredients are used up (finish with 6 biscuits). Cover the cake with cling film, put it in the fridge and leave it to chill for at least 2 hours.

Run a small knife around the edge of the cake and turn it out. Decorate it with the raspberries and the grated macadamia nuts. Garnish with a few mint leaves and serve.

Palmeritas de chocolate.elaboracion:
Lay the puff pastry out on the worktop, sprinkle it with a little sugar and roll the rolling pin gently over it. Turn it over, sprinkle with a little more sugar and roll again. Roll the pastry up from one of the (long) edges to the centre. Do the same with the other edge, until the two rolls meet in the middle.

Cut the pastry into slices about 2 cm thick, lay them on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake them at 190 ºC for 20 minutes. Remove the palmiers and leave them to cool on a wire rack.

Melt the chocolates separately, either in the microwave or in a bain-marie. Dip one side of the palmiers in the dark chocolate, lay them out on a large dish and wait for the chocolate to set. Dip the other side of the palmiers in the white chocolate and wait for it to set (to make the chocolate cool faster, you can put the palmiers in the fridge).

Serve and garnish the plates with a few mint leaves.

Mousse de fresa.elaboracion:
Wash the strawberries, hull them, chop them, put them in the blender jug and blend them with a hand blender until you have a smooth purée. Set aside.

Put the cheese in a large bowl and beat it with an electric whisk. Add the sugar (in three goes) and beat. Add the cream (in 3 goes) and beat. Gradually add the strawberry purée (keep a little back for decoration) and beat the mixture until the ingredients are fully combined. Cover the bowl with cling film, put it in the fridge and leave it to chill.

Serve the mousse in 4 glasses and decorate with the reserved strawberry purée and a few mint leaves.

Peras al vino con yogur.elaboracion:
Heat 200 ml of water, the wine, the cinnamon stick and the sugar in a saucepan over a low heat.

Peel the pears, put them in the pan, cover and simmer gently for 25-30 minutes, turning them from time to time (roughly every 5 minutes). Remove the pears and set them aside on a plate.

Reduce the wine (uncovered), cooking it over a low heat until it has reduced by half. To thicken it a little more, leave it to cool.

Spoon half a yoghurt onto the base of each plate, place the pears on top and coat them with the port reduction. Garnish the pears with a few mint leaves.

Tarta de arándanos.elaboracion:
To make the shortcrust pastry, mix the flour, salt, baking powder and sugar in a large bowl. Add the butter and mix a little. Add the egg and mix a little more. Turn the dough out onto the worktop and knead it until the ingredients are fully combined. Divide the dough into two portions, wrap them in cling film, put them in the fridge and leave them to chill for (at least) 2 hours so it firms up. Take them out of the fridge and knead them gently until they soften slightly.

Dust the worktop with a little flour, place one of the portions of dough on it, roll it out well with a rolling pin and use it to line a 23 cm loose-bottomed tin.

For the filling, mix the cornflour with the sugar and cinnamon in a bowl. Add the blueberries and mix again. Add the lemon juice and mix once more. Spread the filling over the pastry base and fold the overhanging edges in towards the centre.

Dust the worktop with a little more flour, place the other portion of shortcrust pastry on it and roll it out well. Cut long strips 2 cm wide and lay them over the tart in a lattice (criss-crossed strips). Beat the egg yolk and brush the lattice with it using a pastry brush.

Place the tart on the oven rack (put a tray underneath in case any liquid leaks out) and bake it at 200 ºC for 40 minutes. Remove it from the oven, wait for it to cool and turn it out of the tin.

Put the icing sugar in a sieve and dust the tart with it. Garnish with a few mint leaves.

Tarta de cerezas.elaboracion:
To make the pastry, put the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl and mix gently. Dice the butter and add it. Add 1 egg and knead the ingredients until they come together. Turn the dough out onto the worktop and keep kneading until the ingredients are fully combined. Shape the shortcrust pastry into a log and wrap it in cling film. Leave it to rest in the fridge for at least 2 hours (preferably overnight).

Wash the cherries, stone them and put them in a large bowl. Add the sugar, the vanilla essence and the lime zest and mix well. Cover the bowl with cling film and put it in the fridge. Leave the cherries to rest for at least 2 hours (preferably overnight).

Take the shortcrust pastry out of the fridge. Cut off a quarter of the dough and set it aside. Place the rest of the dough on the worktop and knead it a little (just enough to soften it slightly). Dust the worktop with a little flour, place the dough on it, dust it with a little more flour and roll it out with the rolling pin. Use it to line a round loose-bottomed tin, leaving about 2-3 cm of pastry overhanging all the way round. Fill the tart with the cherries, sprinkle them with the cornflour and fold the edges of the pastry over the cherries. Beat the other egg in a bowl and brush the pastry edges with it.

Roll out the reserved piece of shortcrust pastry in the same way as the base and cut it into 1 ½ cm strips. Lay the strips over the cherries in a lattice and (carefully) brush them with the beaten egg.

Bake the tart at 200 ºC for 35-40 minutes. Remove it, leave it to cool and turn it out of the tin.

Decorate with a little whipped cream, a few cherries and a few mint leaves.

Tarta de chocolate del diablo.elaboracion:
Heat 160 ml of water with the cocoa in a saucepan. When it starts to boil and the cocoa dissolves, take the pan off the heat and add the milk and the vanilla extract.

Put the butter and sugar in a bowl and beat them with an electric whisk. Add 1 egg and beat until fully combined. Add the other egg and beat again until combined. Pour the mixture from the saucepan (water, cocoa, milk and vanilla) into the bowl and stir well until you have a smooth batter.

Mix the flour, bicarbonate of soda, baking powder and a pinch of salt in another bowl, sift it over the first bowl and stir the ingredients with a hand whisk until you have a smooth batter.

Grease a round tin with a little butter and line the inside with baking paper. Pour in the batter and bake at 180 ºC for 60 minutes. Take the sponge out of the oven and let it cool slightly. Turn it out and leave it to cool on a wire rack. Cut it into 3 layers.

To make the ganache, heat the cream and the vanilla extract in a saucepan. Add the cocoa and the icing sugar. Heat the ingredients, stirring constantly (with a hand whisk), until fully combined (there is no need to let them boil). Take the pan off the heat, add the butter and keep stirring until it is fully combined. Transfer the mixture to a container and let it cool slightly.

Place one sponge layer on a large plate set on top of an upturned bowl. Cover it with a little ganache, place another sponge layer on top and cover it with ganache too. Finally, add the last layer and cover it with the rest of the ganache so that it runs over the whole top and sides of the 3-layer cake. Serve the cake, arrange the raspberries on top and garnish with a few mint leaves.

Cuajada con salsa de fresa.nombre: Cuajada (sheep's milk junket) with strawberry sauce
Cuajada con salsa de fresa.elaboracion:
Put 3 drops of rennet into each of 4 glasses or pots.

Pour the sheep's milk into a saucepan and heat it over a medium heat until it reaches a temperature of about 50 ºC (check the temperature with a kitchen thermometer). Divide the milk between the 4 pots and wait for it to set. For the strawberry sauce, clean the strawberries, chop 6 of them and put them in a saucepan. Add the sugar and heat until they break down. Chop the rest of the strawberries as you like (into dice or irregular pieces) and set aside.

To serve, spoon a little strawberry sauce over the cuajadas and scatter the chopped strawberries on top. Decorate with a few mint leaves.

Tarta de manzana clásica.elaboracion:
For the shortcrust pastry, mix the flour, salt and butter in a bowl and knead a little. Add the water and keep kneading until the ingredients are fully combined.

Dust the worktop with a little flour, place the dough on it and roll it out with a rolling pin. Line a loose-bottomed tin with the pastry and trim off the excess (by rolling the rolling pin over the top). Cover the pastry case with a piece of baking paper, fill it with baking beans and bake it at 200 ºC for 20 minutes. Take the pastry case out of the oven and remove the paper and the beans. Set the pastry case aside.

For the crème pâtissière, heat the milk (keep a little back) in a saucepan with the vanilla pod (split open) and the lemon peel for 5 minutes, so that the milk is well infused.

In a large bowl, mix the sugar, the cornflour and the reserved (cold) milk. Add the yolks and the egg and whisk until you have a smooth paste. Strain the infused milk over it, mix and transfer everything to the saucepan. Cook over a low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens (about 5 minutes).

Spread the crème pâtissière over the pastry case. Peel the apples, cut them into thin slices and cover the whole surface with them. Bake the tart at 200 ºC for 45 minutes. Remove it, leave it to cool and turn it out of the tin.

Brush the top of the tart with the apricot jam and decorate with the raspberries, the redcurrants and a few mint leaves.

Torrija caramelizada con helado.elaboracion:
Mix the milk and the condensed milk in a saucepan and heat them over a low heat. Add the cinnamon stick and the orange and lemon peel and simmer everything gently for about 6-8 minutes, until the milk is well infused.

Cut the slices of sandwich bread in half and place them in a deep dish. Cover them with the infused milk and wait until they are well soaked.

To stop them breaking, lift them out of the dish with a spatula and place them on a plate. Cover them with the sugar and caramelise them with a blowtorch.

Serve 1 torrija, 1 scoop of ice cream and a few mint leaves on each plate.

Pastelitos de queso con mermelada.elaboracion:
To line the moulds, cut 4 large pieces of baking paper, squeeze and scrunch them up well (as if you were making balls with them). Open them out again and spread them over 4 round ovenproof dishes. To help the paper fit the mould better, you can press it down by putting a glass inside. Place the moulds on a baking tray.

Crack the eggs into a jug. Add the cheese, sugar, flour and cream and blend the ingredients with a hand blender until you have a smooth cream. Divide the cream between the 4 moulds and bake at 200 ºC for 20 minutes. Take the tray out of the oven and leave them to cool.

Turn out the little cheesecakes, serve them and spoon the apricot jam over them. Decorate the plates with a few mint leaves.

Tortilla de chocolate con chantillí.elaboracion:
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a frying pan. Beat 3 eggs in a bowl, add half the sugar, half the chocolate and half the cocoa and mix well. Pour the mixture into the pan and let it set little by little, stirring the ingredients gently. Transfer the omelette to a plate and set aside. Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make another omelette.

To make the Chantilly cream, put the cold cream in a bowl, add the icing sugar and the vanilla essence and whisk the ingredients with an electric whisk until they form peaks. Put the Chantilly cream into a piping bag fitted with a (plain or star) nozzle.

Wash the strawberries, hull them and slice them. Peel the banana and cut it into rounds.

To serve, cut the omelettes in half and serve half on each plate (if you prefer, you can cut it into strips). Accompany with the Chantilly cream, the strawberry slices and the banana rounds. Garnish the plates with a few mint leaves.

Sándwich helado.elaboracion:
Take the ice cream out of the freezer and leave it at room temperature for 15 minutes.

Using an ice cream scoop, make a ball of ice cream and place it on a biscuit, cover the ice cream with another biscuit and press them together a little to make a sandwich. Using a paring knife (small knife), trim off any ice cream that sticks out. Repeat with the rest of the biscuits and the rest of the ice cream.

Place the sandwiches on a dish, cover them with cling film and put them in the freezer until ready to eat.

Melt the chocolate in a bain-marie and transfer it to a small bowl. Put the almond brittle in another bowl as well.

Take the sandwiches out of the freezer. Dip a sandwich halfway into the melted chocolate and then into the almond brittle. Repeat with the rest of the sandwiches. Serve 2 sandwiches on each plate and garnish with a few mint leaves.

Arroz con leche.elaboracion:
Put the milk in a saucepan with the lemon peel and the cinnamon stick and bring it to the boil.

Add the rice and simmer over a very low heat for about 40 minutes, stirring often so that it does not stick.

When the rice is creamy, remove the cinnamon and the peel, add the sugar and cook for a further 5 minutes.

Divide between bowls, leave to cool and sprinkle with ground cinnamon before serving.

Natillas caseras.elaboracion:
Heat the milk with the cinnamon stick and the lemon peel. When it boils, take it off the heat and leave it to infuse for 10 minutes.

Whisk the yolks with the sugar and the cornflour until there are no lumps.

Strain the milk over the yolks, mix and return everything to the saucepan. Cook over a low heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens, without letting it boil.

Divide between bowls, leave to cool and sprinkle with ground cinnamon.

Bizcocho de yogur.elaboracion:
Preheat the oven to 180 ºC and grease a tin with a little oil.

Whisk the eggs with the sugar until pale. Add the yoghurt, the oil and the lemon zest and mix well.

Gently fold in the flour sifted with the baking powder until there are no lumps.

Pour the batter into the tin and bake for about 40 minutes, until a cocktail stick inserted comes out clean. Leave to cool before turning out.

Focaccia.elaboracion:
The day before, make the dough: put the flour, milk, egg yolk, honey, salt and crumbled yeast in a bowl and mix the ingredients until the flour is fully incorporated. Cover the bowl with cling film and leave it to rest for 30 minutes at room temperature (autolyse).

Dust the worktop with a little flour, place the dough on it, spread it out a little and add the butter. Knead (wrapping the butter in the dough) until the butter is fully incorporated.

Put a little oil in the bottom of a large bowl, put the dough in it, cover it with cling film and leave it to rest in the fridge for 24 hours.

Dust the worktop with a little flour, take the dough out of the fridge and stretch it out on the worktop (first with your hands and then with a rolling pin) into a rectangle. Place it on a baking tray lined with baking paper.

Scatter the olives (sliced into rings) and the tomatoes (halved) over the top. Cover the dough with a clean tea towel and leave it to rise until doubled in size (about 1 hour).

In a small bowl, mix the oil with 2 tablespoons of water, 1 sprig of rosemary (chopped) and a pinch of salt.

Press the dough with your fingertips, brush it well with the rosemary oil and sprinkle with the flaky sea salt.

Heat the oven to 230 ºC. Lower the temperature to 190 ºC, put the focaccia in and bake it at 190 ºC for 12-15 minutes. Take it out of the oven and let it cool slightly. Serve and garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves and a few small pieces of rosemary sprig.

Pan de chocolate.elaboracion:
Put the flour, water, salt, crumbled yeast, sourdough starter and cocoa powder in a bowl and mix the ingredients (first with a spatula and then by hand) until the flour is incorporated. Cover the bowl with cling film and leave it to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes (autolyse).

Dust the worktop with a little flour, place the dough on it, dust it with a little more flour and add the butter and the chocolate chips. Knead for 5 minutes, until the ingredients are fully combined.

Put a little flour in a bowl. Place the dough in it, cover with cling film and leave it to rest in the fridge for 24 hours.

Remove the cling film and dust the dough with a little flour. Dust the worktop with a little more flour, place the dough on it, cut it into 4 portions and shape them into 2 round rolls and 2 long rolls. Place the rolls on a baking tray lined with baking paper, slash them down the middle, cover them with a clean tea towel and leave them to prove at room temperature until doubled in size (about 2 hours). Spray the rolls with a little water.

Heat the oven to 200 ºC. Put the rolls in, lower the temperature to 185 ºC and bake them for 20 minutes. Take them out and leave them to cool on a wire rack. Serve.

Coca de trampó con atún.nombre: Coca de trampó with tuna (Majorcan flatbread with vegetables)
Coca de trampó con atún.elaboracion:
To make the dough, put the flour in a large bowl and add the lard, oil, water, baking powder and a pinch of salt. Mix well, turn the dough out onto the worktop and knead it until smooth.

Dust the worktop with a little flour, place the dough on it, roll it out with a rolling pin and place it on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Prick it with a fork and bake it at 180 ºC for about 20 minutes.

Peel the spring onion, removing the outer layer, cut it into large dice and put them in a bowl. Peel the tomatoes, dice them and add them. Wash the peppers (peel the red one), remove the stalks and seeds, dice them and add them. Dress the vegetables with 2-3 tablespoons of oil, the paprika, a pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper. Mix well and leave to marinate for 15 minutes. Drain them well.

Take the base out of the oven (leave the oven on) and spread the vegetables over it. Put the coca in the oven and bake it at 180 ºC for about 20 minutes. Take the coca out of the oven (without turning the oven off), scatter over the capers and the flaked tuna, return it to the oven and bake for a further 5 minutes at the same temperature.

Serve the coca de trampó and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Tartaletas de avena rellenas de pisto y.nombre: Oat tartlets filled with pisto and pork loin
Tartaletas de avena rellenas de pisto y.elaboracion:
To make the dough for the tartlets, put the oat flakes and the flour in a large bowl and mix them. Add the water little by little. Add the oil and a pinch of salt and knead by hand until you have a smooth dough.

Cut the dough into 4 pieces, roll them out with a rolling pin and use them to line 4 individual tartlet tins. To stop the tartlets puffing up, cover them with baking paper and fill them with baking beans. Bake them at 180 ºC for 20 minutes. Remove the tartlets and set aside.

Peel the garlic cloves and dice them. Cut the spring onion the same way. Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and gently fry the garlic and spring onion. Remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper, dice it and add it to the pan. Dice the courgette as well and add it. Cook the vegetables for 6-8 minutes. Peel the tomatoes, dice them and add them. Season with salt to taste and cook everything together for 15 minutes.

Dice the pork loin, season with salt and pepper and sauté it over a high heat in a frying pan with 2 tablespoons of oil. Add it to the pan with the pisto and mix well. Fill the tartlets.

Serve one tartlet on each plate and garnish with a few parsley leaves.

Quiche de panceta y queso.elaboracion:
To make the pastry, put the flour, salt, butter and egg in a large bowl. Knead until the ingredients are fully combined, put the dough in the fridge and leave it to rest for 30 minutes.

Turn the dough out onto the worktop, roll it out with a rolling pin and use it to line a round loose-bottomed tin. Cover the pastry case with baking paper and fill it with a layer of baking beans so that it does not puff up. Bake it at 180 ºC for 30 minutes. Take it out of the oven, remove the beans and set the pastry case aside.

Dice the spring onion, remove the stalk and seeds from the pepper and cut it the same way. Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and gently fry the vegetables for 8-10 minutes. Dice the pancetta, add it and brown it. Chop the cheese, add it, cook briefly and transfer the filling to the pastry case.

Beat the eggs with the cream and a pinch of salt. Pour the mixture into the pastry case so it covers the filling. Bake the quiche at 180 ºC for 20 minutes. Take it out of the oven, let it cool slightly and turn it out of the tin.

Cut the quiche into slices and serve. Garnish the plates with a few parsley leaves.

Bollos de pan integral.elaboracion:
Put the flour in a large bowl. Add the sourdough starter, the crumbled fresh yeast and the water and mix the ingredients a little. Add the salt and keep mixing until the flour is fully incorporated. Cover the bowl with cling film and leave the dough to rest at room temperature for 20-30 minutes (autolyse).

Dust the worktop and the dough with a little flour, take it out of the bowl and knead it for 3-5 minutes. Put it back in the bowl, cover it with cling film, put it in the fridge and leave it to rest for 24 hours.

Dust the worktop with a little flour. Take the dough out of the fridge, dust it with a little more flour and place it on the worktop. Divide the dough into 5 portions and flatten them slightly (to knock the air out). Shape each piece into a ball and then form them into 5 long rolls.

Place the rolls (seam side down) on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Cover them with a clean cotton tea towel and leave them to prove for 2 hours. Score the rolls (make a few cuts in the top with a small knife).

Heat the oven to 220 ºC, put the tray in the oven and pour a glass of water into the bottom of the oven. Lower the temperature to 190 ºC and bake the rolls for 10 minutes. Open the oven to let the steam out. Close the oven again and bake for a further 15 minutes. Take the rolls out of the oven, place them on a wire rack and leave them to cool.

Serve.

Pan casero.elaboracion:
Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water. Mix the flour with the salt in a large bowl and add the water little by little.

Knead for 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. Cover it and leave it in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.

Knock back the dough, shape it into a round loaf and leave it to rise for another 45 minutes on a floured tray.

Bake at 230 ºC with a container of water in the bottom of the oven for 30-35 minutes. Leave to cool on a wire rack.

Panecillos de queso.elaboracion:
Preheat the oven to 200 ºC. Heat the milk with the oil and salt until it boils.

Pour the liquid over the tapioca starch and mix with a spoon until it forms a sticky dough. Leave it to cool slightly.

Add the egg and the grated cheese and knead by hand until the dough is smooth.

Shape into walnut-sized balls, place them on a tray lined with baking paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, until golden.
